The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has declared the SSC JE 2025 Final Result on 3 August 2026. This result is for the Junior Engineer (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical) Examination 2025, conducted for recruitment to Junior Engineer posts in various central government departments. Candidates who appeared in the Tier-1 and Tier-2 exams can check their result status through the official result PDF released by SSC.

Direct Link to Check SSC JE Final Result 2026

SSC JE Final Result 2026 - Quick Overview

SSC released the SSC JE 2025 notification on 30 June 2025 for Junior Engineer posts across Civil, Mechanical, and Electrical disciplines. The written examination (Tier-1) was held from 3 to 6 December 2025, followed by Tier-2 on 7 April 2026. The final vacancy count was revised to 1731 posts, and the Commission has now released the final result along with the result writeup on 3 August 2026.

How to Check SSC JE Final Result 2026

Candidates can check their SSC JE 2025 final result status by following these general steps on the official SSC website:

  3. Click on the link for SSC JE 2025 Final Result (dated 3 August 2026).
  4. Open or download the result PDF and use Ctrl+F (or the search option) to look up your roll number.
  5. Save or print the result PDF for future reference.

Exact on-screen navigation labels on the SSC portal can change from time to time; the official result writeup PDF linked below contains the authoritative process and any additional instructions issued by SSC.

📄 Complete Details & Notification

Punjab National Bank (PNB) has released the PNB LBO Score Card 2026 for candidates who appeared in the Local Bank Officer (LBO) online written examination held on 4 January 2026. The individual scorecard link went live on the official recruitment page on 1 August 2026 and can be accessed through a registration-based login on the ibpsreg.ibps.in portal. This article explains how to download your scorecard, what it contains, the qualifying marks, and the last date to access it.

Direct Link to Check PNB LBO Score Card 2026

PNB LBO Score Card 2026 - Quick Overview

Particulars Details
Organization Punjab National Bank (PNB)
Post Name Local Bank Officer (LBO), Scale I / JMGS-I
Recruitment Notification Date 3 November 2025
Online Written Exam Date 4 January 2026
Written Exam Result / LLPT-Interview Call Letter 24 April 2026
Final Result Declared 23 June 2026
Scorecard Release Date 1 August 2026
Scorecard Portal ibpsreg.ibps.in
Login Credentials Required Registration/Application Number + Password or Date of Birth
Official Website pnb.bank.in

PNB LBO Score Card 2026: Important Dates

Event Date
Recruitment Notification Published 3 November 2025
Online Written Examination 4 January 2026
Notice for Language Test and Interview / Written Result Update 24 April 2026
Local Language Proficiency Test (LLPT) 2 May 2026
Personal Interview 3 to 5 May 2026
Final Result Declared 23 June 2026
Joining Schedule (First Batch) 30 June 2026
Joining Schedule – Second and Final Opportunity 29 July 2026
Individual Scorecard Link Activated 1 August 2026, 4:15 PM
Scorecard Download Window Closes 31 August 2026, 11:55 PM

What the PNB LBO Score Card 2026 Contains

The individual scorecard is a diagnostic document distinct from the result PDF. It is issued to candidates who appeared in the online written test, regardless of whether they ultimately qualified. It typically displays:

  • Candidate's roll number and registration number
  • Section-wise marks scored in the online written examination
  • Overall/aggregate marks
  • Qualifying status (Qualified / Not Qualified) for that stage

Also Read: UP TGT 2026 Special Document Verification Admit Card

How to Download PNB LBO Score Card 2026

  1. Visit the official PNB recruitment page at pnb.bank.in, or go directly to the ibpsreg.ibps.in scorecard login portal.
  2. Locate the notice titled "Link to View Individual Scorecard" under the Local Bank Officer recruitment section.
  3. Enter your Registration Number / Application Number in the first field.
  4. Enter your Password, or your Date of Birth in DD-MM-YYYY format, in the second field.
  5. Click the Login/Submit button.
  6. Your section-wise scorecard will be displayed on screen.
  7. Download the PDF, or use Ctrl+P to save it as a PDF if no direct download option is shown.
  8. Take a printout and store it safely you will need it during document verification and joining formalities.

PNB LBO Written Exam Qualifying Marks (Cut Off)

As reported by exam-preparation portals covering this recruitment cycle, candidates were required to clear both an overall cut off and a minimum sectional cut off in the online written test:

Category Minimum Marks Required Per Section
General / EWS 40%
SC / ST / OBC / PwBD 35%

Note: These sectional cut off percentages are drawn from exam-reporting sources and are consistent with the standard IBPS-pattern cut off structure used in this recruitment; they are Not Available Officially as an explicitly stated figure on PNB's own notice text reviewed for this article. Candidates should cross-check exact figures against their own scorecard.

Separately, some exam-prep sources report an interview qualifying score of 25 out of 50 for General category candidates and 22.5 out of 50 for SC/ST candidates. This detail is Not Available Officially on PNB's recruitment notice board and should be treated as unconfirmed until verified against the official result document.

Documents Required at the Time of Document Verification / Joining

  • Printed copy of the PNB LBO Score Card 2026
  • Final Result / Provisional Selection intimation
  • Valid photo ID proof (Aadhaar, PAN, Passport, Driving License, etc.)
  • Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets
  • Proof of post-qualification banking experience (as applicable to the LBO eligibility criteria)
  • Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD), if applicable
  • Recent passport-size photographs

Also Read: UPSSSC VDO Supplementary Result 2026

Important Instructions

  • The scorecard link is active only for a limited window (1 August to 31 August 2026). Download it before the window closes.
  • Use your registration number rather than your name to search for your record, since candidate names can repeat.
  • Report any discrepancy in personal details on the scorecard to PNB/IBPS immediately rather than proceeding with an incorrect document.
  • PNB has issued a public notice warning candidates against paying any money to anyone for interview calls, selection, or appointment. The bank does not charge any fee for these purposes.
  • Keep your scorecard along with your final result document for document verification and joining formalities.

Selection Process

The two sources reviewed do not fully agree on the selection stages for this recruitment:

  • One source lists: Written Exam, Interview (Viva-Voce), Document Verification, Medical Examination.

  3. You will be redirected to the candidate result/dashboard page.
  4. Enter the following details: Registration Number, Date of Birth, Gender, and Verification Code.

  6. Save a copy of the result for future reference.

Also Read: BSNL JTO Exam Date 2026

JK Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026: Vacancy Details

The 614 vacancies were distributed across the following regions:

Region Vacancies
Jammu & Kashmir (J&K) Region 461
Ladakh Region 18
Other States / Rest of India (ROI) 135

Under the J&K region, major district-wise allocations included Srinagar (75), Jammu (75), Baramulla (35), Anantnag (30), and Budgam (30), among other districts. The Rest of India (ROI) vacancies were allocated to clusters including Delhi, Mumbai, Lucknow, Bangalore, and Mohali.

Selection Process and Exam Pattern

Selection for JK Bank Apprentice 2026 is based on an online written examination followed by document verification. There is no interview stage.

Section Questions Marks Duration
General Awareness & English 50 50 30 minutes
Quantitative Aptitude & Reasoning 50 50 30 minutes
Total 100 100 60 minutes
  • Negative marking of 0.25 marks applies for each wrong answer.
  • No penalty for unattempted questions.
  • The merit list is prepared district-wise and category-wise.
  • A waitlist of 50% of the notified vacancies is maintained for one year from the result date or until the next recruitment exercise, whichever is earlier.

Also Read: RRB Ministerial & Isolated Categories Answer Key 2026

Stipend Details

Selected apprentices will receive a monthly stipend structured as follows:

  • ₹13,500 per month total (₹9,000 from the Bank + ₹4,500 from the Government via DBT)
  • An additional conveyance allowance of ₹1,250
  • No other allowances are provided

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • Keep your registration number and login credentials handy while checking the result.
  • Cross-check your name, roll number, and category details on the result carefully.
  • Selection under this recruitment does not guarantee employment in J&K Bank after the apprenticeship period ends.
  • Domicile candidates of J&K and Ladakh are eligible for bonus marks and age relaxation in future Banking Associate recruitment, as per the original notification.
  • Keep checking the official website for updates on document verification and further stages.

The provisional result (marks statement) is published as Annexure-A along with the official notice on the GSSSB website. To check your marks:

  1. Visit the official GSSSB website: gsssb.gujarat.gov.in.
  2. Go to the "Recruitment" or "Latest Updates" section and look for the Junior Pharmacist, Class-3 (Advt. No. 329/2025-26) provisional result notice.

  4. Scroll to Annexure-A, which lists candidates by Sr. No., Confirmation Number, and Roll Number along with marks obtained.
  5. Locate your roll number or confirmation number to view your score.

Required Documents

This specific result notification does not list document requirements, since it only announces exam marks. Candidates should refer to the original recruitment notification (Advt. No. 329/2025-26) or wait for a future GSSSB communication for document verification requirements.

About the Junior Pharmacist Recruitment

The following background details relate to the original Junior Pharmacist recruitment drive and are sourced from the wider recruitment notification coverage rather than this result notice specifically. Candidates should verify current details on the official GSSSB/OJAS portals.

  • Eligibility: A Bachelor's degree in Pharmacy (B.Pharm) or Doctor of Pharmacy (Pharm.D.), or a Diploma in Pharmacy (D.Pharm) with about two years of relevant experience as a Junior Pharmacist/Dispenser/Pharmacist/Medical Representative in a government, hospital, or pharmaceutical company setting. Registration with the Gujarat State Pharmacy Council is required at the time of appointment, along with basic computer knowledge as per government rules.
  • Salary: A fixed monthly pay during the initial years of service, moving to the regular Pay Level-5 scale after completing the fixed-pay period, as per prevailing Gujarat government pay rules.
  • Application mode: Online, through the OJAS portal (ojas.gujarat.gov.in), under GSSSB Advt. No. 329/2025-26.

The result pertains to Officers in Grade 'B' (DR) – DEPR Cadre, published under Advt. No. RBISB/DA/01/2026-27 dated April 29, 2026. It marks the completion of Phase-I and the start of the Phase-II selection stage.

How to Check Your RBI Grade B DEPR Phase-I Result

This section explains the exact process for confirming your roll number in the official result document, so you know where to look and what to avoid.

The result has been published as a roll-number list within an official PDF on the RBI website. Rather than depending on third-party lists, always verify your own status directly.

  • Visit the official RBI website: www.rbi.org.in, or the Opportunities@RBI recruitment portal.
  • Open the official Phase-I DEPR Result PDF for the roll number list.
  • Use Ctrl+F (or Cmd+F) on the PDF and search for your own roll number.
  • Save or download the PDF for your future reference.

RBI has also noted a standard disclaimer with this result: despite careful preparation, the Board reserves the right to correct any inadvertent errors. If you spot a discrepancy in your details, wait for an official corrigendum rather than relying on unverified sources.

RBI Grade B DEPR Eligibility Criteria

This section outlines the qualification requirement specific to the DEPR cadre, useful for candidates confirming they meet the criteria before Phase-II.

Candidates applying for the DEPR cadre must possess a Master's Degree in Economics, or a Master's Degree in Finance/PGDM/MBA from a recognized university or institution.

RBI Grade B DEPR Phase-II Exam 2026: Key Details

This section explains what to expect in the Phase-II stage, including the exam date, shift structure, and admit card rules points candidates often get confused about.

Phase-II for the DEPR cadre is scheduled for July 26, 2026, and will be conducted in two shifts on the same day. A few important points to note:

  • One exam, two shifts: Candidates must appear for all papers across both shifts attending only one shift is not allowed.
  • Single admit card: RBI will issue only one admit card covering both shifts, unlike exams that issue separate call letters per shift.
  • No logistical flexibility: No request for change of exam date, shift, centre, or venue will be entertained under any circumstance. Plan your travel and stay in advance once your centre is confirmed.

How to Download the RBI Grade B Phase-II Admit Card

This section provides the step-by-step process to download your Phase-II admit card once RBI activates the link.

  1. Visit the official RBI website: www.rbi.org.in.
  2. Locate the Phase-II admit card link under the careers/recruitment section.
  3. Log in using your registration number and password/date of birth.
  4. Download the admit card and verify your exam date, shift timing, and venue carefully.
  5. Along with the admit card, RBI will also release an Information Handout for Phase-II, plus separate instructions for PwBD candidates using a scribe or compensatory time, and for candidates with specified disability (less than 40%) who have difficulty writing.

RBI Grade B Selection Process

This section explains the overall stages of selection for the Officer Grade B recruitment, as outlined in the official notification.

According to the official recruitment details, the selection process comprises:

  • Online Examination (CBT) Phase-I and Phase-II
  • Language Proficiency Test (LPT)
  • Final Merit List

The final merit list is prepared based on combined performance in the online examination and interview, with a reported weightage split of 75:25 (online test : interview), and the interview itself carries 50 marks.

Reports indicate the SBI CBO interview round is scheduled for mid-July 2026, with different sources citing dates of 13 July and 14 July 2026. How Is the SBI CBO Merit Calculated?

The SBI CBO written exam follows a standard negative marking pattern:

MP RAEO Admit Card 2026 - Download link

The direct link to download the MP RAEO Admit Card 2026 will be activated by the Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB) on its official website after the admit card is released. Candidates appearing for the Rural Agriculture Extension Officer (RAEO) / Agriculture Extension Officer (AEO) Group 2 Sub Group 1 Recruitment Exam 2026 can access their hall ticket using their application number and date of birth.

As per MPESB’s usual release pattern, the MP RAEO Admit Card 2026 is expected to be released around 3 to 5 days before the exam date. Since the revised exam date is 5 August 2026, the admit card is likely to be available from 1 August 2026 to 2 August 2026 (expected). However, the exact release date will be confirmed only through the official MPESB notification.

When Will the MP RAEO Admit Card 2026 Be Released?

MPESB has not officially announced the admit card release date for this exam. Going by MPESB's usual pattern for other Group 2 exams (such as MP PNST and MPESB Hospital Assistant, where hall tickets were released in the days immediately before the test), admit cards are generally issued 3 to 4 days before the exam date. Based on this pattern and the revised exam date of 5 August 2026, the RAEO admit card can reasonably be expected around 1-2 August 2026  but this is an estimate based on past trends, not a confirmed MPESB date. Candidates should keep checking esb.mp.gov.in directly for the official release.

How to Download MP RAEO Admit Card 2026

  1. Visit the official MPESB website: esb.mp.gov.in.
  2. Go to the "Admit Card" section on the homepage, once activated for the Group 2 Sub-Group 1 (RAEO/AEO) exam.
  3. Log in using your application/registration number and date of birth (the credentials used at the time of application).
  4. Your MP RAEO Admit Card 2026 will appear on the screen check all details carefully.
  5. Download the admit card and take a clear printout in color or black and white.
  6. Keep at least one extra printed copy along with a valid photo ID for exam day.

Details Mentioned on the MP RAEO Admit Card

Based on the format MPESB follows for its other Group 2 exams, the admit card is expected to carry the following details. Candidates should verify all fields the moment their own admit card is released.

  • Candidate's name, photograph, and signature
  • Application/roll number
  • Exam date, shift, and reporting time
  • Exam centre name and address
  • Category and post applied for
  • General exam-day instructions

Documents to Carry on MP RAEO Exam Day

  • Printed MP RAEO Admit Card 2026
  • A valid original photo ID proof (Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, Driving Licence, or PAN Card)
  • Aadhaar card is required to be unlocked/active for biometric verification at the exam centre, as noted by MPESB for this recruitment cycle
  • Passport-size photograph, if specified on the admit card once released

Exact shift timings for the revised 5 August 2026 exam date have not been officially confirmed. For the earlier-announced 2 August 2026 schedule, MPESB listed the following shift structure, which candidates can use as a general reference until their individual admit card confirms the final timing:

Shift Reporting Time Exam Time

  • A 10-minute instruction-reading period is typically given before the test begins.
  • Electronic gadgets, smartwatches, calculators, and study material are not allowed inside the exam hall.
  • Carry both your admit card and original photo ID entry can be refused without either.

CBI Apprentice Vacancy Details 2026

The Central Bank of India has announced a total of 4,500 Apprentice vacancies for the financial year 2026-27, distributed across various states and union territories. Maharashtra and Uttar Pradesh reportedly have the largest state-wise allocations. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification PDF on the bank's recruitment page for the exact state-wise and category-wise vacancy breakup, since detailed figures for every state were not confirmed in the sources reviewed for this article.

Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must meet the educational qualification, age limit, and nationality conditions set by the Central Bank of India to be eligible for the Apprentice post.

Educational Qualification

  • A graduation degree (bachelor's degree) in any discipline from a recognised university or institute.
  • Candidates should have completed graduation on or after 1 January 2022 (some sources indicate the cut-off as 1 January 2021; candidates should verify the exact date on the official notification).
  • Candidates with one year or more of work or training experience after graduation are not eligible, since this scheme is meant for fresh graduates.
  • Candidates who have already completed apprenticeship training, or are currently undergoing apprenticeship training elsewhere, are not eligible.
  • Basic computer knowledge is required.
  • Candidates must be proficient in the local language of the state they are applying for.

Age Limit

Candidates must be between 20 and 28 years of age as on 31 May 2026, meaning they should be born between 31 May 1998 and 31 May 2006 (both dates inclusive).

Category Age Relaxation

SC / ST 5 years

PwBD (SC/ST) 15 years

Candidates should check the official notification for the exact category-wise age relaxation applicable to them.

Salary / Stipend Details

Selected apprentices will receive a fixed monthly stipend of ₹15,000 during the 12-month training period. This is a training stipend rather than a regular salary, and no other allowances or benefits are provided. Completion of the apprenticeship does not guarantee permanent employment with the bank.

Application Fee

The exact application fee amount for the CBI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 was not confirmed in the sources reviewed for this article. Candidates should refer to the official Central Bank of India Apprentice notification PDF on centralbank.bank.in for accurate, category-wise fee details, since this cannot be reliably stated here.

Selection Process

The Central Bank of India Apprentice selection process involves two stages:

  1. Online Written Examination: An objective-type computer-based test with no negative marking for wrong answers.
  2. Local Language Proficiency Test: Candidates who qualify the online exam may need to appear for a test assessing reading, writing, and speaking skills in the local language of the applied state. Candidates who studied the local language at Class 10 or Class 12 level may be exempted from this test, subject to document verification.

Final selection also depends on document verification and meeting the required medical fitness standards set by the bank.

Documents Required at the Exam Centre

  • Printed copy of the CBI Apprentice Admit Card 2026
  • A valid original government-issued photo ID proof, such as Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Passport, Voter ID, or Driving Licence
  • A photocopy of the photo ID for verification
  • Recent passport-size photographs, as specified in the admit card instructions

Candidates should ensure the name on their ID proof matches the name printed on the admit card to avoid denial of entry.

How to Download the CBI Apprentice Admit Card 2026

Follow these steps to download your Central Bank of India Apprentice hall ticket:

  1. Visit the official website of the Central Bank of India at centralbankofindia.co.in or centralbank.bank.in.
  2. Go to the "Recruitment" or "Careers" section on the homepage.
  3. Click on the "CBI Apprentice Admit Card 2026" or "Download Call Letter" link.
  4. Enter your Registration Number/Roll Number and Password or Date of Birth.
  5. Fill in the captcha code, if required.
  6. Click the Login or Submit button.
  7. Your CBI Apprentice Hall Ticket 2026 will appear on the screen.
  8. Carefully verify all details, including your name, photograph, signature, exam date, and exam centre.
  9. Download the admit card and take a clear printout on an A4 sheet for the examination.

Central Bank of India Apprentice Exam Pattern 2026

The online written examination consists of 100 objective-type questions worth 100 marks, to be completed in 60 minutes, with no negative marking.

Quantitative & Reasoning Aptitude 20 20 English/Hindi

  • Carry the printed admit card; digital copies on a phone or tablet are typically not accepted.
  • Do not carry prohibited items such as mobile phones, smartwatches, calculators, Bluetooth devices, bags, or study material into the exam hall.
  • Check your name, photograph, exam centre address, and category details on the admit card, and report any discrepancy to the helpdesk immediately.
  • Wear simple clothing and avoid accessories like jewellery or metal items, as per standard exam-day dress code guidelines followed by the bank.

Stipend (if selected) ₹15,000 per month during a 1-year apprenticeship
Official Website bankofbaroda.bank.in

Bank of Baroda Apprentice Admit Card 2026 Download Link

Candidates who successfully applied for the BOB Apprentice recruitment between 19 May and 8 June 2026 can now access their admit card online. The hall ticket has been hosted on the official Bank of Baroda careers page, and candidates need their login credentials handy before they try to download it.

  • Official admit card portal: bankofbaroda.bank.in
  • Click Here: Bank of Baroda Apprentice Admit Card 2026
  • Candidates are advised to download and save the admit card well before exam day to avoid last-minute server load or technical glitches.

Bank of Baroda Apprentice Exam Date 2026

This section answers the most commonly searched question when is the BOB Apprentice exam happening. The online test is a single-day, single-shift computer-based exam.

The Bank of Baroda Apprentice Online Examination 2026 is scheduled for June 21, 2026 (Sunday). Candidates should plan their travel to the allotted exam centre in advance and check their reporting time as mentioned on the admit card to avoid last-minute stress.

Credentials Required to Download BOB Apprentice Admit Card

Before logging in to the admit card portal, keep the following details ready. This information is typically the same combination used during registration.

  • Registration Number / Roll Number
  • Password or Date of Birth (as set/used during application)
  • If you have forgotten your password, use the "Forgot Password" option on the login page to retrieve or reset your credentials.

How to Download Bank of Baroda Apprentice Admit Card 2026

This step-by-step guide explains the exact process to access and download your hall ticket from the official website, so you can complete it without confusion.

  1. Visit the official Bank of Baroda website: bankofbaroda.bank.in.
  2. Navigate to the "Careers" or "Current Opportunities" section on the homepage.
  3. Click on the link that reads "Bank of Baroda Apprentice Admit Card 2026."
  4. Enter your Registration Number/Roll Number and Password/Date of Birth in the login window.
  5. Click Submit to view your admit card on the screen.
  6. Check all the details carefully and download the admit card.
  7. Take a clear, color printout for use on exam day.

Details Mentioned on the Bank of Baroda Apprentice Admit Card

Once downloaded, candidates should cross-check every detail printed on the hall ticket immediately, since any discrepancy needs to be flagged to the bank well before the exam date.

The admit card typically includes:

  • Candidate's name, photograph, and signature
  • Registration number and roll number
  • Exam date, reporting time, and exam shift timing
  • Complete exam centre name and address
  • Important exam-day instructions and guidelines issued by the bank

Bank of Baroda Apprentice Exam Pattern 2026

This section explains how the BOB Apprentice online exam is structured, so candidates know exactly what to expect in terms of sections, marks, and timing.

The BOB Apprentice exam is an online objective-type test consisting of 100 questions for 100 marks, to be completed in 60 minutes. The paper is divided into four sections of equal weightage, with no sectional time limit unless specified otherwise in the official notification.

Section Number of Questions Marks
General / Financial Awareness 25 25
Quantitative & Reasoning Aptitude 25 25
Computer Knowledge 25 25
General English 25 25
Total 100 100

Key points about the exam pattern:

  • Each correct answer carries 1 mark.
  • There is no negative marking for wrong answers.
  • No marks are awarded for unattempted questions.
  • The question paper is available in English and Hindi, except for the General English section.

What to Carry on Exam Day

Carrying the right documents is essential, as candidates without a valid admit card or ID proof may be denied entry to the exam centre. This checklist covers what you must bring.

  • A clear, printed copy of the BOB Apprentice Admit Card 2026
  • A valid original photo ID proof (such as Aadhaar Card or PAN Card) the same ID used during the application process
  • A recent passport-size photograph
  • Arrive at the exam centre well before the reporting time mentioned on the admit card

What Happens After the Exam?

This section outlines the next stages of the selection process so candidates know what to expect once the online exam is over.

The Bank of Baroda Apprentice selection process does not end with the written exam. Candidates who qualify in the online test move to the following stages:

  1. Document Verification - Shortlisted candidates must produce original documents for eligibility verification.
  2. Language Proficiency Test - Candidates must demonstrate proficiency in the official local language of the state they applied for.
  3. Medical Examination - A final medical fitness check is conducted before confirmation of selection.

Selected apprentices will be engaged for a one-year apprenticeship period and will receive a stipend of ₹15,000 per month during this engagement.

The Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) has released the notification for CRP CSA-XVI, the 16th Common Recruitment Process for Customer Service Associate (CSA) posts - popularly known as IBPS Clerk Recruitment - in 11 participating Public Sector Banks. The vacancies are for the financial year 2027-28, and online registration opens on 01.08.2026.

Quick answer: IBPS is recruiting for the Customer Service Associate (Clerk) post under CRP CSA-XVI, with indicative state-wise vacancies across 11 public sector banks (not less than 11,403 posts based on the state totals in the notification, though this figure is not stated as a national total in the notification itself - see the Vacancy Details section below). Graduates aged 20–28 years (as on 01.08.2026) can apply. Online registration runs from 01.08.2026 to 21.08.2026, applications are submitted only through the official IBPS website www.ibps.in, and posting is anywhere in India depending on the State/UT a candidate applies for.

IBPS Clerk (CRP CSA-XVI) Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF Out

The eligibility conditions below are the basic criteria for applying. IBPS clarifies that qualifying in the CRP and being provisionally allotted to a bank does not guarantee employment - the concerned bank retains the final say on appointment.

Criteria Details
Nationality Citizen of India, or a subject of Nepal/Bhutan, or a Tibetan refugee who came to India before 01.01.1962, or a person of Indian origin migrated from specified countries with an eligibility certificate from the Government of India
Age (as on 01.08.2026) Minimum 20 years, Maximum 28 years (born not earlier than 02.08.1998 and not later than 01.08.2006)
Educational Qualification (as on 21.08.2026) A Degree (Graduation) in any discipline from a University recognised by the Government of India, or an equivalent qualification recognised by the Central Government
Local Language Proficiency Candidates must be proficient in reading, writing, speaking and understanding the specified/opted local language of the State/UT they apply for (see Local Language Proficiency Test section)
Computer Literacy Mandatory - a Certificate/Diploma/Degree in computer operations, or having studied Computer/IT as a subject in High School/College

IBPS Clerk Qualification for Ex-Servicemen

Ex-Servicemen who do not hold the above civil qualification are eligible if they are matriculate Ex-Servicemen who obtained the Army Special Certificate of Education (or the equivalent Navy/Air Force certificate) after completing at least 15 years of service in the Armed Forces, with the certificate dated on or before 21.08.2026.

IBPS Clerk Age Limit

The standard age limit is 20 to 28 years as on 01.08.2026. Relaxation in the upper age limit is available to reserved categories as follows:

Category Age Relaxation
Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe 5 years
Other Backward Classes (Non-Creamy Layer) 3 years
Persons with Benchmark Disabilities 10 years
Ex-Servicemen/Disabled Ex-Servicemen Actual period of service in defence forces + 3 years (8 years for Disabled Ex-Servicemen belonging to SC/ST), subject to a maximum age of 50 years
Widows, divorced women, and women legally separated (not remarried) Age concession up to 35 years for General/EWS, 38 years for OBC, 40 years for SC/ST

Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC candidates is available cumulatively with only one of the other relaxation categories listed above (Point II 3 to 5 of the notification), not with more than one.

IBPS Clerk Application Fee

The application fee (inclusive of GST) must be paid online between 01.08.2026 and 21.08.2026:

  • SC/ST/PwBD/ESM/DESM candidates: ₹175
  • All other candidates: ₹850

Bank transaction charges for online payment are to be borne by the candidate. Payment can be made via Debit Card, Credit Card, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Cards/Mobile Wallets, or UPI. A correction fee of ₹200 (inclusive of GST) applies if a candidate uses the Edit Window to modify the submitted application.

IBPS Clerk Salary

The Customer Service Associate post carries the following basic pay scale, plus allowances and perquisites as applicable in the allotted participating bank:

Post Basic Pay Scale
Customer Service Associate (CSA) ₹24050-1340/3-28070-1650/3-33020-2000/4-41020-2340/7-57400-4400/1-61800-2680/1-64480

The Customer Service Associate is eligible for allowances and perquisites as per the rules of the participating bank in force from time to time. Exact take-home pay after allowances is not specified in the notification, since it varies bank to bank.

IBPS Clerk Selection Process

Selection for CRP CSA-XVI is a two-tier process consisting of an Online Preliminary Examination and an Online Main Examination, followed by a qualifying Local Language Proficiency Test before joining.

Preliminary Examination (Objective Test)

Test Medium No. of Questions Maximum Marks Time Allotted
English Language English 30 30 20 minutes
Numerical Ability English/Hindi (as opted) 35 35 20 minutes
Reasoning Ability English/Hindi (as opted) 35 35 20 minutes
Total - 100 100 60 minutes

Main Examination (Objective Test)

Test Medium No. of Questions Maximum Marks Time Allotted
General/Financial Awareness English/Hindi (as opted) 40 50 20 minutes
General English English 40 40 35 minutes
Reasoning Ability English/Hindi (as opted) 40 60 35 minutes
Quantitative Aptitude English/Hindi (as opted) 40 50 35 minutes
Total - 160 200 125 minutes

There is a penalty of one-fourth (0.25) of the marks assigned to a question for each wrong answer in both the Preliminary and Main Examinations. No penalty applies to unattempted questions. Candidates must clear individual cut-offs in each test as well as an overall cut-off. Only marks obtained in the Main Examination are considered for the final merit list; Preliminary Exam marks are used only for shortlisting.

Local Language Proficiency Test (LLPT)

Candidates must be proficient in the local language of the State/UT they apply for. Candidates who have studied that language up to Class 10 or above are exempt from a separate test. Others must clear a qualifying (marks-based) Local Language Proficiency Test conducted after the Main Exam/provisional allotment but before joining - failing this test means disqualification from the process.

Provisional Allotment

Shortlisted candidates are provisionally allotted to one of the participating banks based on merit-cum-preference and State/UT-wise vacancies reported to IBPS. A reserve list of approximately 30% of vacancies in each category may also be maintained, though this does not guarantee eventual allotment. Provisional allotment is subject to identity verification and the candidate being found medically fit and otherwise eligible by the allotted bank.

IBPS Clerk - Documents Required

The following original documents (with self-attested photocopies) must be produced at the time of joining/document verification, as applicable:

  • System-generated printout of the online application form
  • Proof of Date of Birth (Birth Certificate or SSLC/Class X certificate with DOB)
  • Photo identity proof as specified in the notification
  • Graduation mark-sheets and degree certificate
  • Class 10 or above mark-sheet/certificate for the local language (if applicable)
  • Caste certificate in the prescribed format (for SC/ST/OBC-NCL candidates)
  • Income and Asset Certificate (for EWS candidates)
  • Disability certificate in the prescribed format (for PwBD candidates)
  • Ex-Servicemen certificates as per Proforma A/B/C/D, as applicable
  • No Objection Certificate (for candidates already in Government/PSU service)
  • Any other document supporting the claimed eligibility

How to Apply for IBPS Clerk Recruitment 2026

Candidates can apply online only - no other mode of application is accepted.

  1. Visit the official IBPS website www.ibps.in and open the "CRP CSA" link, then click "Click Here to Apply Online for CRP – Customer Service Associates (CRP-CSA-XVI)".
  2. Click "Click Here for New Registration" and enter basic details to generate a provisional registration number and password (also sent by email/SMS).
  3. Upload the required scanned documents: photograph, signature, left thumb impression, a handwritten declaration, SSC/SSLC/10th standard or equivalent certificate, and the certificate mentioned in Clause K(ix) if applicable - as per the specifications in Annexure IV of the notification.
  4. Carefully fill in all sections of the online application form using the "Save and Next" facility to verify details before final submission, since most fields cannot be edited after submission.
  5. Indicate the State/UT for which you want to be considered for provisional allotment - this choice is irrevocable once submitted.
  6. Pay the application fee/intimation charges online through the integrated payment gateway (Debit Card/Credit Card/Internet Banking/IMPS/Wallets/UPI).
  7. On successful payment, take a printout of the e-receipt and the completed application form for your records.

Eligibility Criteria for CSC Aadhaar Operator Recruitment 2026

Candidates planning to apply for the CSC Aadhaar Supervisor Operator Bharti 2026 must meet all eligibility conditions set by CSC e-Governance Services India Ltd. The minimum age requirement is 18 years, and no upper age limit is mentioned in the official notification. Age Limit

The minimum age to apply for the CSC Aadhaar Operator Vacancy 2026 is 18 years. No maximum age or age relaxation details are mentioned in the official notification.

Mandatory Certificate Requirement

Every applicant must possess an Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate issued by a Testing & Certifying Agency authorized by UIDAI for delivering Aadhaar services. Additionally, candidates must have basic computer skills. Candidates who do not yet hold this certificate can appear for the Aadhaar Supervisor exam through the link: https://uidai.dexitglobalexams.com/UIDAI/LoginAction.action

Salary / Remuneration - CSC Aadhaar Supervisor Operator 2026

Selected candidates under the CSC Aadhaar Operator Recruitment 2026 will be paid as per the state government's prescribed wage structure. The remuneration for all selected Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator candidates will be the minimum wages of the respective state set for semi-skilled manpower. The exact figure will vary from state to state based on the applicable minimum wage notification of Bihar, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, or Maharashtra.

How to Obtain the Aadhaar Supervisor Certificate Before Applying

Candidates who do not yet hold the mandatory Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate need to complete two steps before they are eligible to apply for CSC Aadhaar Seva Kendra jobs. First, they must apply for and pass the Aadhaar Supervisor exam; second, they must complete the LMS certification. Both processes are managed through official UIDAI platforms.

  1. Visit the Aadhaar Supervisor exam portal at https://uidai.dexitglobalexams.com/UIDAI/LoginAction.action and submit your exam application.
  2. An authorization request will be sent to the State Team. Once approved, you will be permitted to appear for the Aadhaar Supervisor exam.
  3. After your LMS ID and Password are created and approved, appear for the Aadhaar LMS Certification through the portal at https://e-learning.uidai.gov.in
  4. Once certified, proceed to apply for the CSC Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor district post on the CSC Job Portal.

  1. Visit the official CSC Job Portal at career.csccloud.in.
  2. Navigate to the relevant job post for your state - Bihar, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, or Maharashtra.
  3. Click on the "Apply Now" button on the job post page.
  4. Fill in the online application form with your personal, educational, and certification details.
  5. Upload the required documents including your Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate.
  6. Submit the application form before 20 August 2026.

Common Mistakes to Avoid in CSC Aadhaar Operator Recruitment 2026

Many candidates make avoidable errors while applying for the CSC Aadhaar Supervisor Operator Vacancy 2026 that can lead to rejection of their application. The points below are based on common patterns seen in similar contractual government recruitment drives and are not derived from the official notification.

  1. Applying without a valid UIDAI certificate: The Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate from a UIDAI-authorized agency is a mandatory requirement. Applying without it will result in disqualification.
  2. VLEs applying despite ineligibility: VLEs are explicitly barred from applying. Submitting an application as a VLE wastes your time and will be rejected at the verification stage.
  3. Applying for the wrong district: Each vacancy is district-specific. Ensure you apply for the correct district as per your location and preference.
  4. Incomplete LMS Certification: Candidates sometimes have the Supervisor exam cleared but not the LMS Certification. Both are required before applying.
  5. Submitting incorrect documents: Upload clear, legible scans of your educational certificates and Aadhaar Operator certificate. Blurry or mismatched documents can cause rejection.
  6. Missing the last date: The portal closes applications on 20 August 2026. Do not wait until the last day — technical issues near the deadline are common.
  7. Confusing CSC e-Governance with state government jobs: This is a contractual, not permanent government post. Ensure you understand the terms of engagement before applying.

ISRO ICRB Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility

  • Only Indian nationals are eligible to apply.
Post Educational Qualification
Assistant / Upper Division Clerk (Post No. 1, 3 & 5) Graduation with a minimum of 60% marks or CGPA of 6.32 on a 10-point scale from a recognized university, completed within the stipulated duration of the course, AND proficiency in the use of computers.
Junior Personal Assistant / Stenographer (Post No. 2, 4 & 6) Graduation with minimum 60% marks or CGPA of 6.32/10 (completed within stipulated duration) OR Diploma in Commercial/Secretarial Practice with the same marks criteria plus one year of experience as Steno-Typist/Stenographer; AND a minimum speed of 60 words per minute in English Stenography; AND proficiency in the use of computers. (Apprenticeship Training Certificate under BOAT/NATS for DCP/DCCP holders is considered equivalent to one year of Steno-Typist/Stenographer experience.)

ISRO ICRB Recruitment 2026 Age Limit

  • Age reckoning date: 16-08-2026
  • UR/EWS category: Maximum 28 years (born on or after 17-08-1998)
  • OBC category: Maximum 31 years (born on or after 17-08-1995)
  • SC/ST category: Maximum 33 years (born on or after 17-08-1993)
  • Age relaxation as per Government of India orders is applicable to serving government employees, Ex-Servicemen, Persons with Disabilities, meritorious sportspersons, widows, divorced women, and women judicially separated from their husbands who have not remarried.
Category Maximum Age (as on 16-08-2026) Eligible Date of Birth
UR / EWS 28 years On or after 17-08-1998
OBC 31 years On or after 17-08-1995
SC / ST 33 years On or after 17-08-1993

ISRO ICRB Recruitment 2026 Application Fee

  • Application fee for all posts is ₹100.
  • However, all candidates must initially pay a processing fee of ₹500 per application, uniformly.
Post(s) Applied For Fee
Assistant / Upper Division Clerk (ISRO & Autonomous Bodies) ₹500
Junior Personal Assistant / Stenographer (ISRO & Autonomous Bodies) ₹500
Assistant/UDC AND Junior Personal Assistant/Stenographer (combined application) ₹1000

Fee is payable only online through the Bharatkosh e-Payment gateway via Internet Banking, UPI, or Debit Cards (domestic). No other mode of payment (cash, cheque, draft, money order, IPO, etc.) is accepted. The processing fee is refunded in full to candidates exempted from the fee (women, SC/ST/PwBD, Ex-Servicemen) who appear in the written test/CBT; for all other candidates, ₹100 is deducted and the balance refunded, provided the candidate appears in the written test/CBT. Refund is not considered if a candidate fails to appear for the written test/CBT.

ISRO ICRB Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

Written Test

A single objective-type paper of 150 minutes duration (with compensation time for PwBD candidates) will be conducted at 38 venues across India, including Agartala, Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, Bhopal, Bhubaneshwar, Chandigarh/Mohali, Chennai, Dehradun, Delhi, Ernakulam, Gorakhpur, Gurugram, Guwahati, Hyderabad, Indore, Jaipur, Jammu, Jodhpur, Kanpur, Kavaratti, Kolkata, Lucknow, Mangaluru, Mumbai, Mysore, Nagpur, Patna, Port Blair, Pune, Raipur, Ranchi, Shillong, Tiruchirapalli, Thiruvananthapuram, Varanasi, Vijayawada, and Visakhapatnam.

Post Parts Questions / Marks Duration Qualifying Marks
Assistant / UDC (Post 1, 3 & 5) A: General English, B: Quantitative Aptitude, C: General Intelligence & Reasoning, D: General Knowledge 50 Q / 50 Marks each (200 total) 150 minutes 50% (UR), 40% (Reserved categories against notified reserved vacancies)
JPA / Stenographer (Post 2, 4 & 6) A: English Language & Comprehension, B: General Intelligence & Reasoning, C: Quantitative Aptitude & General Knowledge A: 100 Q/100 Marks, B: 50 Q/50 Marks, C: 50 Q/50 Marks (200 total) 150 minutes 50% (UR), 40% (Reserved categories against notified reserved vacancies)

Marking pattern: +1 for correct answer, -0.25 for wrong answer. No TA is paid for attending the written test.

Skill Test

Based on written test performance, candidates are shortlisted for the skill test in the ratio of 1:5 (maximum) to the category-wise number of vacancies.

Post Skill Test Components Passing Criteria
Assistant / UDC Computer Literacy Test (MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint) 60% (UR), 50% (Reserved categories)
JPA / Stenographer Computer Literacy Test + Stenography Test (300 words @ 60 wpm shorthand, 30 minutes computer transcription) Computer Literacy: 60% (UR) / 50% (Reserved); Stenography: max 10% mistakes (UR) / max 12% mistakes (Reserved)

Final selection is based on marks scored in the written test, from among candidates who qualify in the skill test. In case of a tie, tie-breakers are applied in order: (a) marks in General Intelligence & Reasoning (Post 1,3,5) or English Language & Comprehension (Post 2,4,6); (b) date of birth, with the older candidate preferred.

ISRO ICRB Last Date to Apply Online

  • The online application process for ISRO ICRB Recruitment 2026 started on 27 July 2026 at 10:00 AM and will remain open until 16 August 2026 at 11:55 PM.
  • Candidates who meet the prescribed eligibility criteria are advised to complete the registration process well before the last date to avoid last-minute technical issues.
  • Applications are accepted online only through the official ISRO website. Applicants should ensure that all required documents, including their photograph, signature, and applicable certificates, are uploaded correctly before submitting the application.
  • The application fee must also be paid online on or before 16 August 2026 for the application to be considered complete.

Direct Link to Apply Online for ISRO ICRB Recruitment 2026

ISRO ICRB Recruitment 2026 How to Apply

  • Applications are accepted online only, through the ISRO website, between 27-07-2026 (10:00 AM) and 16-08-2026 (11:55 PM).
  • Candidates may apply for more than one post, subject to conditions. A candidate may apply for different posts under the same or different zones but cannot apply for the same post in different zones. Candidates applying for multiple posts must select the same written test centre.
  • Email ID and mobile number are mandatory in the online application; all hall tickets, call letters, and communications will be sent only via registered email/SMS, with no hard copies sent separately.
  • Candidates registered under the National Career Services (NCS) portal and meeting eligibility conditions may follow the same application process on the ISRO website.
  • Candidates must upload a recent colour passport-size photograph (not older than 6 months, .jpg/.jpeg, 20–50 KB, 200x230 pixels preferred) and signature (.jpg/.jpeg, 10–20 KB, 140x60 pixels preferred), along with SC/ST/Disability/Ex-servicemen certificates where applicable.
  • Applications not conforming to the notified requirements, or incomplete applications, will not be considered.

ISRO ICRB Recruitment 2026 Remuneration

  • Selected candidates will be appointed as Assistant / Junior Personal Assistant / Upper Division Clerk / Stenographer in Level 4 of the Pay Matrix.
  • Minimum basic pay: ₹25,500 per month.
  • Additional allowances: Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA), and Transport Allowance as per extant Central Government rules.
  • Employees will be governed by the New Pension Scheme.
  • Other benefits: medical facilities for self and dependents, subsidised canteen, limited quarters facility (in lieu of HRA), Leave Travel Concession, Group Insurance, and House Building Advance, as admissible per Central Government orders.
Component Details
Pay Level Level 4 of Pay Matrix
Minimum Basic Pay ₹25,500 per month
Allowances DA, HRA, Transport Allowance
Pension New Pension Scheme
Other Benefits Medical facilities, subsidised canteen, limited quarters (in lieu of HRA), LTC, Group Insurance, House Building Advance

Important Instructions

  • Candidates employed under Central/State Government, PSUs, or Autonomous Bodies must submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer at the time of the Skill Test. Failure to submit the original NOC will result in the candidate not being permitted to appear for the Skill Test, and TA will not be paid.
  • PwBD candidates applying for reserved posts must submit a self-attested Disability Certificate in the prescribed format, indicating percentage of disability (minimum 40% relevant disability required for reservation eligibility), issued by a duly constituted Medical Board.
  • OBC candidates must possess a valid OBC certificate (non-creamy layer, in the prescribed proforma) as on the last date of application. EWS candidates must possess a valid Income and Asset Certificate for financial year 2026–2027.
  • Candidates attending the Skill Test will be reimbursed second-class railway fare (to and fro, shortest route) from the city indicated in the application to the Skill Test venue. No TA is payable for the Written Test.
  • All original documents must be produced at the time of the Skill Test in support of details furnished online. False information will result in disqualification from the Skill Test, and TA will not be paid.
  • Answer keys will be published on the ISRO website within three working days of the written test. Objections, with valid justification, may be raised only through the designated link within 5 days of publication; objections received after this window or through any other mode will not be considered.
  • Appointees are liable to be posted or transferred to any Centre/Unit of the Department of Space/ISRO at any time, based on requirement. The number of vacancies indicated is provisional, and ISRO reserves the right to increase, decrease, or not fill the posts without assigning any reason. The posts are temporary but likely to continue.
  • Any court case or legal matter arising from this recruitment falls under Bangalore, Karnataka jurisdiction. Canvassing in any form will result in disqualification.
  • Candidates are advised NOT to take cognizance of any fake offer of appointment for jobs in ISRO.
  • In case of ambiguity between the Hindi and English versions of the notification, the English version shall be treated as final.

Mineral Exploration and Consultancy Limited (MECL), a Mini-Ratna-I Central Public Sector Enterprise under the Ministry of Mines, Government of India, has invited online applications for 13 Executive Trainee posts in Electrical and Mechanical disciplines. This recruitment is conducted through the UPSC Engineering Services Examination (ESE) 2024 score, for candidates who cleared the written round and appeared for the ESE 2024 interview but were not recommended for final selection by UPSC. Online registration opens on 1 August 2026 and closes on 14 August 2026, through the MECL Recruitment Portal at www.mecl.co.in. Eligible candidates must hold a B.E./B.Tech in the relevant Electrical or Mechanical discipline with a minimum of 60% marks, and the maximum age limit is 28 years (UR) as on the crucial date of 1 August 2026. Selected candidates will be posted at MECL projects and offices across India.

MECL Executive Trainee Eligibility Criteria

Candidates applying for the MECL Executive Trainee Recruitment 2026 must meet the educational qualification and age limit given below, and must also have cleared the written round of UPSC ESE 2024, appeared for the ESE 2024 interview, and consented to sharing their score information on UPSC's website, without having been recommended for final selection.

MECL Executive Trainee Salary

Selected candidates will be placed as Executive Trainees during a one-year training period at an initial Basic Pay of ₹40,000 per month in the E-1 (IDA) pay scale of ₹40,000–₹1,40,000, along with applicable Industrial Dearness Allowance (IDA). In addition to Basic Pay and IDA, the posts carry other benefits including:

  • Provident Fund (PF) and National Pension System (NPS)
  • Performance Related Pay
  • Group Medical Insurance
  • MECL-Employee Defined Contributory Superannuation Scheme

An application registration fee of ₹500 is applicable for General/OBC/EWS candidates. The fee is not applicable for SC/ST/PwD/Ex-Servicemen/Departmental candidates. Payment must be made online through Net-Banking or a QR code hosted on the MECL website under the Careers section. The fee, once paid, is non-refundable and cannot be adjusted against any other examination or selection.

MECL Executive Trainee Selection Process

The MECL Executive Trainee Recruitment 2026 selection process is based entirely on the UPSC ESE 2024 score, with no separate written examination or personal interview conducted by MECL:

  1. Applicant lists will be prepared in decreasing order of marks (out of 1200) scored in UPSC ESE 2024, category-wise, for the Mechanical/Electrical discipline.
  2. Eligible candidates will be shortlisted based on the UPSC ESE 2024 score and other eligibility criteria, as per MECL's extant Recruitment Rules.
  3. Shortlisted candidates will be called for a Document Verification round.
  4. If documents are found suitable and matching the advertisement criteria, offers of employment will be issued.

In case of a tie in total UPSC ESE 2024 score, seniority in age (as per Matriculation certificate) will be considered first, followed by a higher aggregate percentage in the essential engineering degree.

How to Apply for MECL Executive Trainee Recruitment 2026

Candidates can apply for the MECL Executive Trainee Recruitment 2026 by following these steps:

  1. Visit the official MECL website: www.mecl.co.in and go to the "Career" section.
  2. Register on the MECL Online Recruitment Portal with all mandatory details.
  3. Log in and click on "Apply for a Post" to fill the online application form.
  4. Enter personal details, educational qualification, UPSC ESE 2024 score, and category/community details accurately.
  5. Upload the required scanned documents in the specified format and file size.
  6. Pay the application fee (₹500 for General/OBC/EWS candidates, where applicable) online.
  7. Submit the application before the closing date of 14 August 2026.
  8. Take a printout of the system-generated application form for future reference.

Applications received through any mode other than the MECL Online Recruitment Portal will not be accepted and will be summarily rejected. Candidates are advised not to wait until the last date to apply.

MECL Executive Trainee Recruitment 2026: Important Instructions

  • Only Indian nationals are eligible to apply.
  • Selected candidates will undergo one year of training and may be posted at any MECL Project/Office/Establishment in India.
  • The appointee will be on probation for one year, extendable by up to one further year at the discretion of the Appointing Authority.
  • Executives/Executive Trainees must serve a minimum of 36 months after joining; a retention deduction of ₹5,000 per month will be made from salary, refundable (without interest) on completion of 36 months' service.
  • A service bond of ₹1.8 lakh must be executed to serve the company for a minimum of 36 months.
  • Appointment is subject to the candidate being declared medically fit by a Government Medical Officer/CMO of a Government Hospital, covering parameters such as vision, hearing, cardiovascular health, and more.
  • Category certificates must be valid as of the crucial date (01.08.2026); UPSC ESE 2024 category status does not automatically apply to MECL's process.
  • Candidates working in Central/State Government, PSUs, autonomous bodies, or nationalized banks must apply through proper channel or furnish a No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of document verification.
  • MECL reserves the right to increase, decrease, or not fill any of the advertised vacancies, or to cancel, restrict, enlarge, modify, or withdraw the recruitment process at any stage, without prior notice.
  • Corrigenda or amendments will be published only on the MECL website (www.mecl.co.in) under the Career section; no further press advertisement will be issued.
  • Candidates should not register more than once for the same post; if multiple applications are submitted, only the one with the higher Application Number will be considered.
  • For technical queries related to the MECL Recruitment Portal, candidates may email [email protected] with screenshots of the issue.

Konkan Railway Corporation Limited (KRCL) has released KRCL Recruitment 2026 (Employment Notification No. CO/P-R/02/2026, dated 31.07.2026) inviting online applications for 201 vacancies across 12 Non-Executive posts in Civil, Signal & Telecommunication (S&T), Operating, Electrical, Mechanical, and Commercial departments.

The posts include Junior Engineer (Civil), Track Maintainer, Senior Section Engineer (S&T and Mechanical), ESTM-III, Section Controller, Station Master, Goods Train Manager, Assistant Loco Pilot, Junior Engineer (Mechanical), Technician-III (Mechanical), and Commercial Supervisor. The online application window will open tentatively during the last week of August 2026, with the exact date to be published on the KRCL website 7 days in advance. The Computer Based Test (CBT) is tentatively scheduled for September 2026. Eligible candidates - land losers, Employment Exchange-registered candidates along the Konkan Railway route, and domiciles of Maharashtra, Goa, or Karnataka - can apply through the official website, www.konkanrailway.com.

KRCL Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF Out

KRCL Recruitment 2026 Eligibility to Apply

KRCL Recruitment 2026 is open to the following categories of candidates:

  • Land Loser Candidates: Candidates whose land was acquired for construction of the Konkan Railway Line between Roha (Maharashtra) and Thokur (Karnataka), irrespective of the percentage of land lost. The land loser and/or their spouse, son, daughter, grandson, or granddaughter are eligible under the landloser quota.
  • Employment Exchange Registered Candidates: Domiciles of Maharashtra, Goa, or Karnataka with valid employment exchange cards registered along the Konkan Railway route (Raigad, Sindhudurg, and Ratnagiri districts of Maharashtra; Goa State; Uttara Kannada, Udupi, and Dakshina Kannada/South Kannada districts of Karnataka).
  • Other Domicile Candidates: Candidates domiciled in the States of Maharashtra, Goa, or Karnataka (not covered above).
  • KRCL Employees: Serving KRCL employees who have completed at least 3 years of regular service.

Note: Recruitment in the erstwhile Group-D post - Track Maintainer - is limited to eligible Land Loser candidates only.

Preference in Recruitment

Candidates securing the minimum qualifying marks are given preference for recruitment in the following order:

  1. Land Loser candidates (first preference)
  2. Candidates registered in Employment Exchanges along the KR route (second preference)
  3. Candidates domiciled in Maharashtra, Goa, or Karnataka, and KRCL employees (third preference)

Candidates must declare their status (Land Loser/Employment Exchange/Domicile) at the time of application; this choice is final. The second and third panels are operated only after exhausting the panel of eligible land losers.

KRCL Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details

KRCL has announced 201 vacancies across 12 posts. Category-wise reservation (UR/EWS/OBC-NCL/SC/ST) is shown in parentheses against each post; the notification also provides horizontal reservation for Ex-Servicemen (Ex.SM) and PwBD within these totals.

KRCL Recruitment 2026 Reservation Policy

This notification provides Vertical Reservation for SC, ST, OBC-NCL, and EWS, and Horizontal Reservation for Ex-Servicemen (Ex.SM) and Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD).

  • EWS Reservation: Candidates not covered under SC/ST/OBC-NCL reservation, whose family gross annual income is below Rs. 8 lakh and who do not own specified categories of land/property, can claim EWS reservation with a valid Income & Asset Certificate.
  • Note: EBC and EWS are different categories - EBC candidates get fee concession only, not job reservation.
  • Horizontal Reservation: Ex-Servicemen and PwBD reservations are included within the post-wise vacancies shown above, irrespective of social community. Ex.SM and PwBD candidates can also apply against unreserved vacancies of posts not exclusively earmarked for them (PwBD candidates only where the post is indicated as suitable for their disability), and are eligible for age relaxation and fee exemption.
  • PwBD Categories: VI (Visually Impaired: Blind/Low Vision), HI (Hearing Impaired: Deaf/Hard of Hearing), LD (Locomotor Disability: One Arm/One Leg/One Arm-Leg/Dwarfism) - subject to a minimum of 40% disability. One Commercial Supervisor post is reserved for PwBD candidates.
  • EWS, SC, ST, and OBC-NCL candidates who qualify without relaxed standards will not be adjusted against reserved vacancies and will be considered under UR.

KRCL Recruitment 2026 Exam Pattern (CBT)

The recruitment process varies by post group:

  • Section Controller, Station Master, Assistant Loco Pilot: CBT → Computer-Based/OMR-based Aptitude Test → Document Verification (DV) → Medical Examination. Merit is prepared with 70% weightage to CBT marks and 30% to Aptitude Test marks.
  • Senior Section Engineer (Mechanical/S&T), Junior Engineer (Civil/Mechanical), Goods Train Manager, Commercial Supervisor, Technician-III (Mechanical), ESTM-III: CBT → Document Verification → Medical Examination.
  • Track Maintainer: CBT → Document Verification → Physical Efficiency Test (PET) → Medical Examination.

The CBT is of screening nature with negative marking - one mark is deducted for each wrong answer. Questions are set in five languages: English, Hindi, Marathi, Konkani, and Kannada (the Aptitude Test for SCOR/SM/ALP is in English and Hindi only).

The full unit-wise technical syllabus for each post - covering subjects such as Engineering Mechanics, Strength of Materials, Building Materials & Construction, Surveying, Thermal Engineering, Basic Electricity/Electronics, and related topics - is detailed separately in the official notification (Section 14.7 to 14.14) and should be reviewed in full by candidates preparing for the CBT.

PET is mandatory and qualifying in nature, conducted in two stages - Weight Carrying first, followed by a Running Test. Failing the Weight Carrying stage results in elimination at that stage itself.

KRCL Recruitment 2026 Application Fee

SC / ST / Ex-Servicemen / Female / Minorities / EBC / PwBD Fee is refunded (minus bank charges) upon appearing in the CBT

Fee is payable online only, through Internet Banking, Debit/Credit Cards, or UPI. Minorities include Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Buddhists, Jains, and Zoroastrians (Parsis). Economically Backward Class (EBC) candidates - annual family income below Rs. 50,000 - get fee concession only, not job reservation. There is no refund for erroneous, incomplete, or rejected applications.

KRCL Recruitment 2026 Documents Required

Candidates should keep scanned copies of the following ready before filling the online application:

  • SC/ST certificate (for candidates seeking free rail travel passes)
  • PwBD candidates: additional passport-size photograph as per specification, and Scribe details/photograph if applicable

At the time of Document Verification (DV), candidates must produce original documents along with self-attested photocopies, including:

  • Matriculation/High School Certificate (proof of Date of Birth and qualification)
  • HSC, Graduation, and ITI/NCVT-SCVT certificates as applicable
  • Aadhaar Card and PAN Card
  • Domicile certificate (Maharashtra/Goa/Karnataka)
  • SC/ST/OBC-NCL caste certificate in the prescribed Annexure format, where applicable
  • Income Certificate for EBC fee waiver / EWS Income & Asset Certificate, where applicable
  • PwBD certificate as per the prescribed Annexure, where applicable
  • NOC from current employer (for serving Govt./PSU employees) and discharge certificate (for Ex-Servicemen)
  • Land Loser candidates: SLAO Land Loser Certificate, Tehsildar's certificate, proof of relationship, and RTC land documents, as applicable

How to Apply for KRCL Recruitment 2026

Interested and eligible candidates can apply online for KRCL Recruitment 2026 by following these steps:

  1. Visit the official KRCL website, www.konkanrailway.com, once the application link goes live (tentatively last week of August 2026).
  2. Register your name on the portal; a Registration Number will be generated and sent via registered email and mobile number, along with a password and application link.
  3. Activate the link to access the application form and fill in personal, educational, and category details, carefully selecting your post-wise preference (this cannot be changed once submitted).
  4. Pay the prescribed examination fee online for each CBT Examination Group selected, using Net Banking, Debit/Credit Card, or UPI.
  5. Upload the required scanned documents - photograph, signature, and category certificates (if applicable).
  6. Review all entries carefully, then submit the application before the closing date.
  7. Keep a printed copy of the submitted online application for future reference - do not send it to KRCL by post.

Candidates are advised to apply only through the official KRCL website and to be cautious of fake websites and job racketeers, as KRCL has not appointed any agents or coaching centres on its behalf.

KRCL Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Candidates can apply for one or more posts in a single application, in order of preference; once exercised, post preference is final and cannot be changed.
  • KRCL will allot only one post to a selected candidate, based on preference, merit, vacancy position, and qualifying the selection stages - no request for a lower-preference post will be entertained after allotment.
  • Serving Government/PSU employees may apply directly but must produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer at the time of DV, failing which their candidature will be cancelled.
  • Selected candidates can be posted anywhere within KRCL's area of operation, including project sites; KRCL employees are not eligible for transfer to other Zonal Railways.
  • Candidates must ensure their mobile number and email ID are active throughout the recruitment process, as all communication will be via SMS and email only.
  • Any candidate found using unfair means, impersonation, or furnishing false information will be disqualified and debarred from future KRCL examinations, and is liable for legal action.
  • KRCL reserves the right to change the number of vacancies, cancel the recruitment process in part or full, and reject applications without assigning reasons.

Boiler BE/B.Tech in Chemical / Petrochemical / Mechanical / Instrumentation / Electrical, plus a valid Boiler Operation Engineer's Certificate (BOE) or Boiler Proficiency Certificate from a Statutory Authority 60% (55% for SC/ST)
Mechanical BE/B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering (or 3-year degree after diploma, or dual/integrated degree) from UGC/AICTE-approved institutions 60%
Electrical BE/B.Tech in Electrical Engineering / Electrical and Power Engineering / Electrical Power Engineering 60% (55% for SC/ST)
Instrumentation BE/B.Tech in Instrumentation Engineering / Instrumentation Technology / Instrumentation and Control Engineering 60% (55% for SC/ST)
Materials BE/B.Tech in Chemical, Petrochemical, Chemical Technology, Mechanical, Electrical, Electrical and Power, Instrumentation, Instrumentation Technology, or Instrumentation and Control Engineering (this post is reserved for ST/PwBD-Low Vision category as per the notification) 55% for ST category
Civil BE/B.Tech in Civil Engineering or allied disciplines (Civil and Infrastructure Engineering, Construction Engineering, Construction Technology and Management, etc.) 60%
Fire BE/B.Tech in Fire or Fire & Safety discipline from UGC/AICTE-approved institutions 60%
CC Lab Ph.D. in Chemistry (preferred) OR BE/B.Tech in Chemical Engineering / Petrochemical Engineering / Chemical Technology No percentage criteria for Ph.D.; 60% for engineering graduates
Industrial Engineering BE/B.Tech in Industrial Engineering, OR BE/B.Tech in any discipline plus a 2-year PG degree/diploma in Industrial Engineering, Industrial Engineering and Management, or Industrial Engineering and Operations Research 60% in the qualifying degree
Information Technology BE/B.Tech in Information Technology / Computer Science / Computer Technology / Computer Engineering 60% (55% for SC)
Rajbhasha Master's degree in Hindi with English as a compulsory/elective subject or medium of examination, or Master's degree in English with Hindi as compulsory/elective, or Master's degree in another subject with Hindi and English combinations as specified in the notification 60% in final year of post-graduation
Finance CA/CMA, OR a full-time graduation degree in Commerce/Accounting/Finance (B.Com, BMS, BAF, BBA) plus a 2-year full-time MBA/MMS/PGDM with specialisation in Finance. M.Com alone is not considered. No percentage criteria for CA/CMA; 60% for the postgraduate route (55% for SC/ST)
Marketing Full-time Science/Engineering/Agriculture graduate plus a 2-year full-time MBA/MMS/PGDM with specialisation in Marketing or Agri-Business Management/Agriculture 60% (55% for SC/ST)

For all disciplines, wherever CGPA/OGPA/SGPA or a letter grade is awarded, candidates must convert it to an equivalent percentage as per the norms of their university or institute and mention this in the application. Candidates in the final year of graduation or post-graduation are not eligible to apply.

RCF Management Trainee Age Limit

The upper age limit is calculated as on 01.02.2026 and varies by category. The general pattern followed across most disciplines is given below; a few posts (such as Boiler, Materials, CC Lab, Rajbhasha, Civil, and Fire) have narrower category-specific age limits because reservation is not notified for every category in those posts. Candidates should refer to the specific post-code table in the official notification for the exact age limit applicable to their category and discipline.

Category Upper Age Limit (general pattern, most disciplines)
UR / EWS 27 years
OBC (NCL) 30 years
SC / ST 32 years
PwBD (UR/EWS) Up to 37 years, where notified for the post
PwBD (SC/ST) Up to 42 years, where notified for the post
PwBD (OBC-NCL) Up to 40 years, where notified for the post

An additional age relaxation of 5 years is available to children/family members of victims of the 1984 riots, across all categories. Age relaxation for SC/ST and OBC(NCL) candidates applying against reserved posts is up to 5 years and 3 years respectively; PwBD candidates get further relaxation as specified in the notification.

RCF Management Trainee Salary

Selected candidates undergo a one-year training period and are paid a lump sum stipend of ₹60,000 per month during this period. Free hostel accommodation on a sharing basis is provided at Trombay/Thal, along with medical facility at the RCF Hospital.

On successful completion of training, trainees are absorbed in the E1 Grade with a pay scale of ₹40,000–₹140,000. The minimum total monthly gross emoluments (Basic Pay + VDA at 51.80% + Perks at 34% + HRA at 30% and other allowances) work out to approximately ₹86,320. Management Trainees posted outside Trombay and Thal (such as at Marketing Area Offices) additionally receive a fixed allowance of ₹5,000 per month towards boarding, lodging, and local travel, plus TA/DA on tours.

A bond amount of ₹2 lakh must be deposited by the Management Trainee at the time of joining as a fixed deposit with lien marked to RCF Ltd, for a period of 4 years including the one-year training period. On absorption, employees also become eligible for company accommodation (subject to availability), Performance Related Pay, free medical facility for self and dependents, gratuity, contributory provident fund, accident insurance, and pension scheme as per company rules.

RCF Management Trainee Application Fee

Category Application Fee
General / OBC (NCL) / EWS ₹1,000 plus applicable bank charges and GST
SC / ST / Ex-Servicemen / PwBD / Female candidates Exempted - no application fee

Fees can be paid online only, through internet banking, debit card, or credit card. Once paid, the application fee is non-refundable under any circumstances, so candidates are advised to verify their eligibility before making the payment.

Also Read: BPCL Non Management Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 154 Technician & Operator Posts

RCF Management Trainee Selection Process

The RCF Management Trainee Selection Process consists of an Online Test followed by a Personal Interview.

Online Test

  • Computer-based objective test of 90 minutes, with 100 questions in total.
  • 50 questions (2 marks each) are from the course curriculum of the relevant discipline/qualifying degree.
  • 50 questions (1 mark each) cover General English, Quantitative Aptitude, Reasoning, and General Knowledge/Awareness.
  • There is negative marking for wrong answers.
  • The test is conducted in Hindi (Rajbhasha) and English, at centres in Bhopal, Delhi/Delhi NCR, Lucknow, Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Chennai, Guwahati, Kolkata, Mumbai/Navi Mumbai/Thane/MMR region, and Nagpur.

Personal Interview

  • Based on online test performance and document verification, eligible candidates are provisionally called for interview in a ratio of approximately 1:7 (7 candidates per post).
  • Candidates must score a minimum average of 50% in the interview to qualify.
  • Outstation candidates are reimbursed III-tier AC train/bus fare for both the online test and interview, as per the terms in the notification.

Final Merit List

Parameter Weightage
Online Test 80%
Personal Interview 20%

Separate category-wise and discipline-wise merit lists are prepared. Candidates with nil or negative marks in the online test are not eligible for interview. Final selection is also subject to a pre-employment medical examination and document verification.

RCF Management Trainee Required Documents

  • Recent passport-size colour photograph (4.5cm × 3.5cm) as per specified scan requirements
  • Signature scanned on white paper with black ink
  • Left thumb impression on white paper with black or blue ink
  • Handwritten declaration (in the candidate's own handwriting, in English) as per the format given in the notification
  • Valid photo identity proof (PAN Card, Passport, Driving Licence, Voter's Card, Aadhaar, etc. - Ration Card and Learner's Licence are not accepted)
  • Caste certificate in the prescribed proforma, where applicable (SC/ST/OBC-NCL)
  • Income and Asset Certificate for EWS candidates, issued on or after 1 April 2025
  • Disability certificate for PwBD candidates, as per the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Rules, 2017
  • No Objection Certificate (NOC), for candidates currently employed in Government/PSU/Autonomous Bodies
  • Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets relevant to the applied discipline

How to Apply for RCF Management Trainee Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official RCF website, www.rcfltd.com, and click on "Apply Online".
  2. Choose "Click here for New Registration" and enter your name, contact details, and email ID to generate a Provisional Registration Number and Password.
  3. Fill in the application form, using "Save and Next" to complete it in stages if required.
  4. Upload the scanned photograph, signature, left thumb impression, and handwritten declaration as per the specifications in the notification.
  5. Upload other required documents (single combined PDF file per category, maximum 500 KB) as listed in the advertisement.
  6. Preview and validate all details before clicking "Complete Registration".
  7. Pay the application fee online, where applicable, and take a printout of the e-receipt.
  8. Click "Submit" to complete the RCF Management Trainee Apply Online process.

RCF Management Trainee Apply Online: Important Instructions

  • Only online applications are accepted; physical application forms will not be considered.
  • Details submitted in the online application form, including correspondence address, email address, mobile number, category, post applied for, and test city, cannot be changed after submission.
  • Candidates must possess a valid personal email ID and mobile number, kept active throughout the recruitment process, as all communication will be sent electronically.
  • Candidates already employed in Central/State Government, Quasi-Government, PSUs, or Autonomous Bodies must apply through proper channel or submit a No Objection Certificate at the time of interview.
  • RCF reserves the right to cancel, restrict, enlarge, or modify the recruitment process, and to increase or decrease the number of vacancies, without prior notice.
  • Any corrigendum or update will be published only on www.rcfltd.com under "HR → Recruitment"; no separate press advertisement will be issued.
