What Is a Bharat Sarkari Job?

A Bharat Sarkari Job is any government job opportunity offered across India's central and state government departments - spanning all 28 states and 8 union territories. The term "Bharat" simply emphasises pan-India coverage: a Bharat Sarkari Job notification could originate from a central body like the SSC, UPSC, or Indian Railways, or from a state public service commission recruiting for state-level posts. Regardless of origin, these roles share the defining traits Indian aspirants seek - long-term job security, government pay scales, and statutory retirement benefits.

Sarkari Job vs Private Job

A sarkari job differs from private-sector employment in a few important ways: government positions are governed by service rules that protect against arbitrary termination, salaries follow Pay Commission recommendations rather than market negotiation, and employees are entitled to pension schemes (NPS or OPS depending on recruitment year), medical coverage under CGHS, and fixed working hours. Private jobs, by contrast, often offer higher starting pay in competitive fields but carry less structural job security.

Sarkari Bharat Vacancies by Sector

Sarkari bharat vacancies span several major recruiting sectors. Each sector below links to a dedicated hub page with sector-specific notifications, eligibility criteria, and exam patterns.

Banking Jobs (IBPS, SBI, RBI)

Banking recruitment includes IBPS PO, IBPS Clerk, SBI PO, SBI Clerk, RBI Assistant, and NABARD postings. These roles are among the most competitive sarkari bharat jobs, offering strong starting pay and clear promotion tracks. Browse current openings on our Banking Jobs hub.

Railway Jobs (RRB NTPC, ALP, Group D)

Indian Railways is the country's largest single recruiter, with RRB NTPC, Group D, ALP, JE, and Technician posts opening in large batches. Check live Railway vacancies on our Railway Jobs hub.

Defence Jobs (Army, Navy, Air Force)

Defence recruitment covers Indian Army (including Agniveer), Navy, Air Force, BSF, CRPF, CISF, and ITBP postings. See ongoing openings on our Defence Jobs hub.

Teaching Jobs (KVS, NVS, State Boards)

Teaching sarkari jobs include KVS, NVS, DSSSB, and state education board recruitment for TGT, PGT, and PRT posts. Explore current teaching vacancies on our Teaching Jobs hub.

SSC & UPSC Notifications

SSC (CGL, CHSL, MTS, GD) and UPSC (Civil Services, CDS, NDA) notifications remain the most closely tracked central-government exams. Full notification archives are available on our SSC Jobs and UPSC Jobs hubs.

Sarkari Job Find - Filter by Qualification & State

Not every sarkari job requires a degree. Use the qualification and state filters below to sarkari job find openings that actually match your eligibility, instead of scrolling through listings you don't qualify for.

Sarkari Job for 10th Pass / 12th Pass

Several high-volume recruiters - including Railways (Group D), SSC (MTS, GD), and state police departments - recruit primarily at the 10th pass and 12th pass level. Browse these openings on our 10th & 12th Pass Jobs page.

Sarkari Job for Graduates & Postgraduates

Graduate and postgraduate-level sarkari jobs include SSC CGL, Bank PO, UPSC Civil Services, and various state PCS exams. See qualification-matched listings on our Graduate Jobs page.

State-Wise Sarkari Bharat Job (Bihar, UP, Tamil Nadu, and more)

State government recruitment is listed separately by state, since eligibility and domicile rules vary. Find your state's current openings via our State Government Jobs directory.

सरकारी फॉर्म ऑनलाइन 2026 कैसे भरें? (How to Apply Online)

हर साल लाखों उम्मीदवार सरकारी फॉर्म ऑनलाइन 2026 भरने की प्रक्रिया में गलतियाँ कर बैठते हैं, जिससे उनका आवेदन रद्द हो सकता है। नीचे दी गई सरल प्रक्रिया से आप अपना फॉर्म सही तरीके से भर सकते हैं।

आवेदन की चरणबद्ध प्रक्रिया

  1. संबंधित विभाग की आधिकारिक अधिसूचना (Notification PDF) ध्यान से पढ़ें और अपनी पात्रता जांचें।
  2. वैध ईमेल आईडी और मोबाइल नंबर से पोर्टल पर पंजीकरण (Registration) करें।
  3. व्यक्तिगत विवरण, शैक्षणिक योग्यता, और आवश्यक दस्तावेज़ अपलोड करें (फोटो, हस्ताक्षर, प्रमाणपत्र)।
  4. निर्धारित आवेदन शुल्क का ऑनलाइन भुगतान करें और भुगतान की रसीद सुरक्षित रखें।
  5. फॉर्म सबमिट करने से पहले सभी जानकारी की दोबारा जांच करें और फॉर्म का प्रिंटआउट अवश्य लें।

Documents Required for Sarkari Form

Typical documents needed: recent passport-size photograph (as per specified size/format), scanned signature, educational certificates and mark sheets, category certificate (if applicable), and a valid ID proof (Aadhaar/PAN).

Common Mistakes to Avoid While Applying

  • Submitting a photo or signature that doesn't match the specified pixel/size requirements.
  • Missing the last date due to server load - apply at least 2–3 days before deadline.
  • Entering a name or date of birth that doesn't match your certificates exactly.
  • Forgetting to download and save the final submitted form and payment receipt.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is a Bharat Sarkari Job?

A Bharat Sarkari Job refers to any government job opportunity across India's central and state departments - including Railways, Banking, SSC, UPSC, Defence, Police, and PSUs - offering job security, fixed pay scales, and pension benefits under government service rules.

How can I get instant Sarkari Job Alert notifications?

You can bookmark this page for daily updates, or subscribe to OnlyJobs's notification service to receive a Sarkari Job Alert as soon as a new central or state vacancy is announced.

Where can I check the latest Bharat Job Result 2026?

All declared results - including written exam results, merit lists, and interview outcomes - are listed in the Results section of this page, updated as soon as departments release official Bharat Job Result notices.

How do I find a Sarkari Job that matches my qualification?

Use the qualification filters on this page to sarkari job find openings suited to 10th pass, 12th pass, diploma, graduate, or postgraduate candidates, sorted by sector and state.

सरकारी फॉर्म ऑनलाइन 2026 में आवेदन कैसे करें?

सबसे पहले संबंधित विभाग की आधिकारिक अधिसूचना पढ़ें, पात्रता जांचें, फिर वैध ईमेल और मोबाइल नंबर से रजिस्ट्रेशन करके फॉर्म भरें, दस्तावेज़ अपलोड करें और आवेदन शुल्क जमा करें।

Is OnlyJobs reliable for sarkarijob updates?

Yes - OnlyJobs has tracked sarkarijob notifications since 2011, cross-verifying every listing against official department websites before publishing.

What is the difference between a Sarkari Job and a private-sector job?

Sarkari jobs offer government-backed job security, pension (NPS/OPS), fixed working hours, and statutory benefits, while private jobs typically offer market-driven pay with fewer long-term security guarantees.

Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 – FAQ's

How to apply for Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 online?

Visit your state's official WCD / ICDS portal (link provided in table above). Register with mobile & Aadhaar, fill the application form, upload documents (photo, 10th certificate, Aadhaar, domicile), and submit before the last date. Print the application acknowledgement slip after submission.

What is the eligibility for Anganwadi Worker 2026?

Candidates must have passed 10th or 12th standard from a recognized board. Age limit is 18–35 years (varies by state). Must be a permanent resident of the ward/village for which vacancy exists. Only female candidates are eligible for Worker and Helper posts.

What is the salary of Anganwadi Worker in 2026?

Anganwadi Worker receives a monthly honorarium of ₹10,000–₹20,000 depending on the state (Karnataka and TN are highest at ~₹14,000). Anganwadi Helper gets ₹5,000–₹7,000/month. The Central Government pays ₹4,500/month as base honorarium, and states add their own component on top.

Is there a written exam for Anganwadi jobs?

No, there is no written examination for Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper posts. Selection is purely merit-based on academic qualification marks (10th / 12th percentage). For Supervisor / CDPO posts, a written exam or interview may be conducted depending on the state.

What is the age limit for Anganwadi Helper?

Age limit is 18 to 35 years as of 1st January 2026 in most states. SC/ST candidates get 5 years relaxation (maximum age 40). OBC candidates get 3 years relaxation (maximum age 38). PwD candidates get additional relaxation as per state rules.

What documents are required for Anganwadi job application?

Required documents: Aadhaar card, 10th/12th marksheet and certificate, domicile/residence certificate, caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC), passport-size photograph, scanned signature, and EWS/PwD certificate if applicable. Graduation certificate is needed for Supervisor post applications.

What is ICDS recruitment 2026?

ICDS stands for Integrated Child Development Services - the government programme under which Anganwadi centres operate nationwide. ICDS recruitment 2026 refers to hiring of Anganwadi Workers, Helpers, Supervisors, and CDPOs by state WCD departments under the Ministry of Women & Child Development (wcd.nic.in).

Is Anganwadi Worker a permanent government job?

Anganwadi Workers and Helpers are honorary workers, not regular government employees. They receive a fixed monthly honorarium (not salary) and are entitled to benefits like ESI, health insurance, and maternity benefits. Supervisors and CDPOs are regular government employees in most states and receive full pay & grade pay.

Can I apply for Anganwadi job from a different district?

No. Anganwadi Workers and Helpers must be permanent residents of the same ward/village/district where the vacancy exists. A domicile or residence certificate is mandatory. Applications from outside the specified locality are rejected. For Supervisor/CDPO posts, the same district residency rule generally applies.

Forest Department Posts List

The forest department offers a range of posts across different levels, from ground-level field roles to gazetted officer positions. Most current openings on this page are for Group C posts - Forest Guard, Forester, Beat Guard, and Field Guard - making this a common landing point for anyone searching forest department group c recruitment 2026.

  • Forest Guard - entry-level field post responsible for forest protection and anti-poaching patrols
  • Forester - supervises Forest Guards and manages a forest beat or range sub-unit
  • Forest Beat Officer - field-level post combining patrol, record-keeping, and community liaison duties; commonly searched as forest beat officer notification 2026
  • Range Forest Officer (RFO) - manages an entire forest range, includes administrative and enforcement responsibilities
  • Assistant Conservator of Forests (ACF) - gazetted officer post, typically recruited through state forest service exams
  • Indian Forest Service (IFS) Officer - recruited through UPSC, the highest field-level forestry cadre in India

Eligibility for Forest Department Jobs 2026

Educational Qualification

  • Forest Guard / Forest Watcher / Field Guard: 10th or 12th pass from a recognized board
  • Forester: 12th pass, often with Science subjects; some states require a diploma in Forestry
  • Range Forest Officer: Graduate degree, frequently in Science, Agriculture, or Forestry
  • ACF / IFS: Graduate degree in a relevant discipline (Botany, Zoology, Forestry, Agriculture, Veterinary Science, Engineering, or Environmental Science), followed by the respective state or UPSC exam

Age Limit & Relaxation

The general age limit for Forest Guard and Forester posts is usually 18–27 years, though this varies by state. Age relaxation is generally available for SC/ST (5 years), OBC (3 years), PwBD candidates, and other reserved categories as per government norms.

Reservation & Age Relaxation for Ex-Servicemen

Most state forest departments reserve a fixed percentage of Forest Guard, Forester, and Beat Guard posts for ex-servicemen, in addition to SC, ST, OBC, and EWS reservations. Candidates applying for jobs for ex servicemen in forest department typically receive:

  • Additional age relaxation, usually 3–5 years beyond the general age cap (or as per length of military service)
  • Relaxed physical standards in several states
  • A reserved vacancy quota, separate from the general merit list

Exact quota percentages and relaxation norms differ by state, so always cross-check the specific notification before applying.

Physical Standards

Most Forest Guard and Forester posts require candidates to clear height, chest measurement (for male candidates), and a Physical Efficiency Test involving running, walking, or trekking - since the job involves regular field patrol duty in forest terrain.

Selection Process & Exam Pattern for Forest Officer & Forest Guard Posts

The selection process for forest department recruitment generally involves multiple stages, designed to test both academic knowledge and physical fitness given the field nature of the job.

Written Exam, PET/PST & Document Verification

  1. Written Examination - objective-type questions on General Knowledge, General Science, Reasoning, Mathematics, and sometimes Forestry/Environment-related topics
  2. Physical Efficiency Test (PET) / Physical Standard Test (PST) - running, walking/trekking distance, height and chest measurement
  3. Document Verification - verification of educational certificates, age proof, category certificates, and (where applicable) ex-servicemen discharge documents
  4. Medical Examination - fitness check before final appointment
  5. Final Merit List - based on combined written exam and PET/PST scores, as per each state's weightage formula

Syllabus Highlights for Forest Guard & Ranger

  • General Knowledge & Current Affairs
  • General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology basics)
  • Basic Mathematics / Numerical Ability
  • Reasoning & Mental Ability
  • State-specific General Knowledge (local geography, forests, wildlife sanctuaries)
  • For Ranger/RFO level: Forestry science, environmental laws, and wildlife protection acts

Q7: What is the salary for forest guard and forest officer posts in 2026?

Forest Guard salary typically ranges from ₹28,000 to ₹35,000 gross per month under Pay Level 3, while Range Forest Officer and ACF posts range from ₹50,000 to ₹95,000 depending on pay level. Full breakdown is in the salary table above.

Q8: Is there a written exam for forest guard recruitment 2026?

Yes, most states conduct a written exam covering General Knowledge, General Science, Reasoning, and Mathematics, followed by a Physical Efficiency Test (PET) and document verification before the final merit list is prepared.

Two Types of No Exam Govt Jobs

No-exam recruitment in India falls into two patterns, and knowing which one a notification belongs to tells you exactly what to prepare for:

Type Typical Posts Who it's for How Selection Works
Fresher - no exam, usually no interview Apprentice, GDS, trainee 10th/12th/ITI/Diploma/Graduate pass Merit list prepared from academic marks
Experienced - no exam, interview-based Officer, manager, specialist, medical Professionals with relevant work experience Shortlisting based on qualification/experience, followed by a personal interview

How Recruitment Without Exam Works in Government Jobs

This section explains the different routes through which government departments fill vacancies without conducting a written competitive exam.

1. Direct Recruitment

Certain senior and specialised posts - such as Chairman, Member, and Secretary in Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) and State Public Service Commissions (PSCs) - are filled through direct recruitment based on eligibility criteria like qualifications, experience, and domain expertise, rather than a written exam. Similarly, some administrative posts in the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) may be filled through direct recruitment.

2. Sports Quota Recruitment

Government organisations such as Indian Railways, the Indian Army, and Public Sector Banks reserve a quota of posts for candidates with outstanding achievements in sports at the state, national, or international level. Eligible candidates can be appointed to posts like Assistant Station Master, Ticket Collector, and Clerk without going through the regular written exam.

3. Cultural Quota Recruitment

Indian Railways also recruits individuals with exceptional talent in arts, fine arts, music, or literature under the cultural quota for posts such as Junior Clerk, Ticket Collector, and Assistant Loco Pilot.

4. Internal Promotions and Deputation

Government departments, including the Indian Administrative Service (IAS) and Indian Police Service (IPS), promote existing employees to higher posts based on performance, seniority, and experience - without requiring them to clear a fresh competitive exam. Ex-servicemen and defence personnel are also often considered for civilian government posts through deputation or reservation quotas, without a written exam.

5. Apprenticeships and Trainee Programmes

Railways, PSUs, and central organisations like DRDO and BEL regularly hire Act Apprentices, Trade Apprentices, and Project Trainees through merit lists based on academic marks - with no written entrance test.

6. Walk-in Interviews

Some government and PSU organisations directly call candidates for walk-in interviews based on their qualifications and experience, especially for technical, medical, and contractual roles.

Government Jobs Without Exam by Sector

This section breaks down no-exam opportunities by sector - banking and railways - which are among the most common areas where such recruitment occurs.

Bank Jobs Without Exam

While most public sector bank recruitment (PO, Clerk, SO) happens through IBPS or bank-specific written exams, some banks fill specific posts - such as Local Bank Officer and certain Specialist Officer roles - through direct recruitment, where the bank shortlists applications based on eligibility criteria and conducts an interview instead of a written test.

Railway Jobs Without Exam

Indian Railways and the various Railway Recruitment Boards/Cells (RRBs/RRCs) offer no-exam entry through:

  • Act Apprentices (selection via academic merit list)
  • Sports Quota posts (Assistant Station Master, Ticket Collector, Clerk)
  • Cultural Quota posts (Junior Clerk, Ticket Collector, Assistant Loco Pilot)
  • Scouts and Guides Quota

Before You Apply: How to Spot Fake "No Exam" Job Offers

No-exam recruitment is the single biggest magnet for job fraud in India, because "direct joining, no exam" is exactly what scammers promise. Four rules protect you:

  1. No genuine government post is ever sold. Nobody - agent, "officer", consultancy - can arrange selection for money. The only payment in real recruitment is the application fee, paid on the official portal, typically a few hundred rupees.
  2. Verify the notification on the official domain. Every real notice lives on a .gov.in, .nic.in or official PSU domain. Every row in our list links to the post page where the official notification PDF and apply link are attached - if an offer you received isn't traceable to an official notice, treat it as fraud.
  3. No recruitment happens over WhatsApp or Telegram DMs. Forwarded "joining letters" and interview calls demanding a deposit are scams, full stop.
  4. Cross-check suspicious notices against PIB Fact Check before sharing or paying anything.

How to Apply for Government Jobs Without Exam

  1. Open the post from the live list and read the official notification PDF - eligibility, age limits and fee are final there, not in any summary.
  2. Confirm you match the qualification and category requirements before paying any fee.
  3. Apply on the official portal linked in the notification; keep the registration number and fee receipt.
  4. For merit-list posts (GDS, apprentice), enter marks exactly as on your certificates - mismatches reject applications at verification.
  5. Track the post page for merit list / shortlist updates, or subscribe to WhatsApp/Telegram alerts so deadlines and results reach you automatically.

Government Jobs Without Exam - FAQs

1. Are there really government jobs without an exam?

Yes. Apprenticeship intakes, India Post GDS, sports and cultural quota posts, walk-in interviews and direct recruitment for experienced candidates are all filled without a written competitive exam. The live list at the top of this page shows every such notification currently open.

2. Which government jobs have no exam and no interview at all?

India Post GDS and Railway/PSU Act Apprentice selections use only a merit list of academic marks - there is no written test and no interview. Everything depends on your Class 10 (and ITI/diploma, where applicable) percentage.

3. What no-exam options exist for freshers after 10th, 12th or ITI?

Apprenticeships, GDS and trainee posts are the main fresher routes. Selection is a merit list prepared from academic marks, which is why these notifications attract very high application volumes despite no exam.

4. Can experienced professionals get a government job without an exam?

Yes. PSUs and autonomous bodies fill officer, manager and specialist posts by shortlisting candidates on qualification and experience, followed by a personal interview - no written test.

5. Are government jobs without exam permanent?

Often not. Apprenticeships are roughly one-year training engagements with a stipend, and many walk-in posts are contractual with fixed tenure. Direct-recruitment posts can be regular - the notification states the nature of each post, so check before applying.

6. Are there bank jobs without an exam?

A few. Some banks fill specialist and local officer posts through shortlisting plus interview. Bank apprenticeship drives vary - some are merit-based while others include an online test - so read each notification's selection clause.

7. Are there railway jobs without an exam?

Yes: Act Apprentice intakes (merit list), sports quota, cultural quota and Scouts & Guides quota. Apprentice intakes are large; the quota routes are small zonal recruitments with their own assessment process.

8. Is India Post GDS really without an exam?

Yes - selection is an online merit list generated from Class 10 marks, with no exam and no interview. Because of that, GDS is heavily targeted by paid-selection scams; apply only through the official GDS portal.

9. How do I identify fake "no exam" job offers?

No genuine government post is sold, fees are paid only on official portals, and no recruitment happens over WhatsApp or Telegram messages. Verify every offer against the official notification on a government or PSU domain - if it isn't there, it's fraud.

10. How often is this list updated?

Daily. New notifications are added as they release, and every listing is removed automatically after its last date, so the list only ever shows posts you can still apply for.

Govt Jobs for Law Graduates - Eligibility (LLB, LLM, BL)

Eligibility varies by post, but the core requirement for almost every government law job is a recognised law degree. Senior and specialised roles add experience, an LLM, or Bar enrolment on top.

Educational Qualification

  • Bachelor of Law (BL) / LLB (Legum Baccalaureus): the baseline qualification for most legal and law officer posts.
  • LLM (Master of Laws): required for senior legal officer, faculty, and some advisory positions.
  • Integrated 5-year degrees - BA LLB, BBA LLB, BCom LLB - are accepted wherever an LLB is required.

The degree must be from a university recognised by the Bar Council of India.

Bar Council Enrolment & AIBE

For litigation, prosecutor, and standing-counsel roles you generally need to be enrolled as an advocate with a State Bar Council, and many positions ask for the All India Bar Examination (AIBE) Certificate of Practice issued by the Bar Council of India. Purely advisory or research posts (Law Clerk, Research Fellow, Legal Consultant) often do not require enrolment.

Age Limit & Relaxations

The upper age limit is typically 30 to 40 years for the general category, depending on the post and recruiter. Statutory relaxations apply: usually 3 years for OBC, 5 years for SC/ST, and additional relaxation for PwD and ex-servicemen candidates. Always confirm the exact limit and cut-off date in the official notification, as judicial-service and PSU limits differ.

Salary & Pay Scale for Government Law Jobs

Pay depends on the organisation and grade. Officer-level legal posts under the 7th Pay Commission generally fall in Pay Levels 10 to 12, with a monthly salary roughly between ₹56,100 and ₹1,77,500, plus Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, and other benefits. PSU legal officers are paid on IDA scales, which can be higher at entry grade.

Types of Law Officer / Legal Posts in Government Sector

  • Judicial Services - Civil Judge (Junior Division), Additional District Judge, High Court Judge, recruited via State Judicial Service Exams (PCS-J)
  • Law Officer / Legal Officer - Roles in public sector banks (IBPS SO Law), insurance companies (LIC AAO Legal), regulatory bodies (SEBI Grade A Legal), and PSUs (Coal India, NTPC, GAIL Legal)
  • Legal Assistant & Legal Advisor - Administrative legal support roles in ministries, universities, and district courts
  • Assistant Public Prosecutor (APO) - Prosecution roles recruited through State PSCs, requiring LLB and often a minimum years of practice

Judicial Services (Civil Judge, ADJ, High Court Judge)

Judicial Services is the most prestigious and highest-paying career path for LLB graduates. Recruitment happens through State Public Service Commissions (e.g., RPSC, UPPSC, MPPSC) via a three-stage exam: Preliminary, Mains, and Interview. Civil Judge posts typically require 0-3 years of practice depending on the state, while some states allow fresh LLB graduates to apply directly.

Law Officer / Legal Officer (Banks, PSU, Insurance)

Public sector banks and insurance companies recruit Law Officers through specialist officer (SO) exams. These posts require only an LLB degree (AIBE not mandatory) and offer competitive pay scales under the 7th Pay Commission equivalent structure, along with allowances.

Legal Assistant & Legal Advisor Posts

These are typically Group B/C administrative-legal posts in ministries, universities, and PSU legal departments, requiring an LLB degree and sometimes relevant drafting/litigation experience.

Assistant Public Prosecutor (APO)

APO recruitment is conducted by State PSCs (e.g., RPSC Assistant Prosecution Officer) and requires an LLB degree, enrollment as an advocate, and in most states, a minimum period of practice (often 3 years).

Selection Process for Law Govt Jobs

The selection process differs by post but commonly includes:

  1. Written examination - testing legal knowledge, aptitude, and general awareness (for judicial services and most exam-based posts).
  2. Interview / viva-voce - assessing legal reasoning and suitability.
  3. Document verification - degree, Bar enrolment, AIBE, age, and category certificates.

Advisory and consultant posts are often filled by shortlisting and interview alone, without a written exam.

Law Govt Jobs FAQ's

What are the latest law govt jobs in 2026?

Current law government jobs in 2026 include Law Officer, Legal Officer, Assistant Prosecution Officer, Judicial Service, and Legal Adviser posts across High Courts, PSUs, public sector banks, and central/state departments. The table above is updated daily with vacancy count, last date, and the official notification link.

Which departments hire LLB and law graduates?

High Courts and District Courts, the Ministry of Law and Justice, UPSC, State Public Service Commissions, public sector banks, PSUs, insurance companies, and regulatory bodies regularly recruit law graduates for legal and judicial roles.

What is the eligibility for government law jobs?

Most posts require a Bachelor of Law (LLB/BL) from a recognised university; senior roles may require LLM and experience. Litigation and prosecutor posts usually require enrolment with a State Bar Council and, often, the AIBE certificate.

What is the salary of a Law Officer in the government sector?

A government Law Officer or Legal Officer typically earns between ₹56,100 and ₹1,77,500 per month under the 7th Pay Commission, depending on the organisation, plus DA, HRA, and allowances. PSU legal officers draw IDA-scale pay.

Can a fresher LLB graduate get a government job?

Yes. Freshers can apply for Civil Judge (Junior Division) judicial-service exams, Law Clerk and Research Fellow posts in High Courts, and trainee legal roles. Some PSU and bank Law Officer posts require a few years of post-enrolment experience.

How can I apply for law officer vacancies in central government?

Open the post in the table above, read the official notification, register on the recruiter's portal, fill in the application with your LLB and enrolment details, pay the fee, and submit before the last date.

What is the difference between Judicial Services and Law Officer posts

Judicial Services (Civil Judge, via state judiciary exams) places you on the bench as a judge. Law Officer/Legal Officer posts are departmental legal-counsel roles in PSUs, banks, and ministries - advisory and litigation support, recruited by interview or written test.

Is there an age limit for govt law jobs?

Most posts set the upper age at 30 to 40 years for the general category, with statutory relaxations for OBC, SC/ST, and PwD candidates. Check each notification, as judicial-service and PSU limits differ.

How SSC JE Final Cut Off 2026 Was Calculated

The final cut off is based on total marks scored in the exam by candidates who successfully completed the Sliding and Identity Verification process. Candidates who did not clear this verification step have not been included in the final cut off or result, even if their earlier tier marks were high enough.

How Ties Are Resolved in the SSC JE Merit List 2026

If two or more candidates score the same total marks, SSC applies a fixed tie-breaking sequence:

  1. Candidates with higher Paper-II marks are ranked higher.
  2. If the tie remains, Paper-I Part (i) marks are considered next.
  3. If still tied, Paper-I Part (ii) marks are considered.
  4. If scores remain equal, the older candidate is given preference.
  5. If required, final ranking is decided based on alphabetical order of candidates' names.

What Happens After the SSC JE Cut Off 2026 Announcement

Shortlisted candidates will be contacted by their allotted departments for document verification and appointment formalities. A few points to keep in mind:

  • SSC does not prepare any reserve or waiting list.
  • Vacancies arising from non-joining candidates will be carried forward to future recruitment cycles.
  • SSC will make candidates' e-dossiers available to the concerned departments through the online e-Dossier module.
  • If no communication is received from the allotted department, candidates should reach out after waiting for up to six months from the final result date.
  • The SSC JE Final Answer Key, response sheets, and detailed marks of both selected and non-selected candidates will be published on the official SSC website in due course.

Also Read: Bihar BSSC Office Attendant Final Result 2026

Documents Typically Needed at the Verification/Joining Stage

This information is not available in the official notification/source in full detail for this specific cycle. As a general practice for SSC JE selections, departments typically ask for original certificates and their photocopies at the joining stage, such as educational qualification certificates, category certificate (if applicable), identity proof, and photographs — candidates should confirm the exact list from the joining letter or communication sent by their allotted department, since requirements can vary by department.

How to Download the SSC JE Final Cut Off 2026 PDF

  1. Visit the official SSC website: ssc.gov.in.
  2. Go to the "Result" section on the homepage.
  3. Click on the link for SSC JE Junior Engineer (Civil, Mechanical & Electrical) Examination 2025 Final Result and Cut Off.
  4. Open or download the Final Cut Off PDF.
  5. Check your department code and category to find the applicable cut off mark.

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • Cross-check your roll number and department allocation directly from the official PDF, not from third-party summaries alone.
  • Keep your registered mobile number and email active, since departments may reach out for verification and joining formalities.
  • Do not make any payment or share documents with anyone claiming to expedite the joining process outside official department communication.
  • Retain copies of your admit card, response sheet, and result printout for future reference.

How to Download IOB Apprentice Admit Card 2026?

Candidates can download their IOB Apprentice Call Letter 2026 by following these steps:

  1. Open the registered email ID that was used during the application process.
  2. Look for the email sent by BFSI SSC containing the IOB Apprentice Call Letter 2026.
  3. Open the email and click on the admit card download link, or download the attached PDF if provided.
  4. Check every detail on the admit card, including your name, roll number, exam date, reporting time, and exam-day instructions.
  5. Download and save the admit card on your device.
  6. Take at least two clear printouts of the hall ticket and carry one along with a valid photo ID on exam day.

Details Mentioned on the IOB Apprentice Admit Card 2026

Candidates should verify each of the following details carefully upon downloading their call letter:

  • Candidate's Full Name & Roll Number
  • Registration Number & Post Discipline (Apprentice)
  • Exam Date, Shift Timing & Reporting Time
  • Complete Name & Address of Exam Centre (or remote exam instructions, as applicable)
  • Candidate's Photograph & Digital Signature
  • Category & Gender
  • Exam Day Rules & Code of Conduct

IOB Apprentice Exam Pattern 2026

The online examination consists of 100 objective-type questions carrying 100 marks, to be completed in 90 minutes, across four sections:

Section No. of Questions Maximum Marks
General / Financial Awareness 25 25
General English 25 25
Quantitative & Reasoning Aptitude 25 25
Computer or Subject Knowledge 25 25
Total 100 100

IOB Apprentice Admit Card 2026: Important Instructions

  • Carry a clear printed copy of the IOB Apprentice Call Letter along with an original photo ID such as Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Voter ID, Passport, or Driving Licence.
  • Check the reporting time mentioned on your admit card and reach the reporting location (exam centre, or your home setup if the exam is confirmed as remote-proctored) well ahead of the scheduled time.
  • Do not carry mobile phones, smartwatches, calculators, Bluetooth devices, or any study material into the examination hall, if attending at a physical centre.
  • Ensure your photograph, signature, and other personal details on the admit card are clearly visible before exam day.
  • If the exam is remote-proctored, ensure a working device with a front camera, microphone, and stable internet connection, as per the instructions on your specific call letter.

What to Do in Case of an Issue in the IOB Apprentice Admit Card 2026?

If any discrepancy is found on the admit card, candidates should act promptly:

  1. Verify the name, date of birth, and category details carefully.
  2. Check whether the photograph and signature are clearly visible.
  3. Confirm the exam date, time, and exam centre/mode details.
  4. Contact the helpdesk through the official support channels on iob.in or the BFSI SSC portal if any information is incorrect.
  5. Keep the application form and registration details ready while requesting corrections.
  6. Download the corrected IOB Apprentice Admit Card PDF once the issue is resolved.

Union Bank of India Apprentice Selection Process

SBI CBO Final Result 2026: What the PDF Says

The official final result notice, signed by the General Manager, states that the listed roll numbers belong to candidates provisionally selected as Circle Based Officers. The selection is explicitly subject to two conditions mentioned in the PDF:

  • Qualifying the Proficiency Test in Local Language(s)
  • Fulfilment of eligibility criteria and conditions as prescribed in Advertisement No. CRPD/CBO/2025-26/18 dated 29.01.2026

This means candidates whose roll numbers appear in the list have not yet received a final, unconditional offer - the Local Language Proficiency Test and document/eligibility verification are still pending. The official PDF does not state the total number of candidates selected; this figure is Not Available Officially at this time.

How to Download SBI CBO Final Result 2026 PDF

  1. Visit the official SBI careers portal at sbi.bank.in.
  2. Go to the "Careers" section and click "Current Openings."
  3. Look for "Recruitment of Circle Based Officer" against Advertisement No. CRPD/CBO/2025-26/18.
  4. Click the final result / list of provisionally selected candidates link.
  5. Use Ctrl+F (on desktop) to search your roll number or registration number in the PDF.
  6. Download and save the PDF for future reference.

What Happens After the SBI CBO Final Result?

Provisionally selected candidates should watch for further communication from SBI regarding:

  • Local Language Proficiency Test schedule (Not Yet Announced)
  • Document verification / biodata form submission
  • Joining formalities and posting circle confirmation

Selected candidates will be posted in the Circle of the State against which they applied and selected, and will not be entitled to an inter-circle transfer until promotion to SMGS-IV grade or completion of 12 years of service, whichever is later - as per the terms of the original advertisement.

Important Instructions

  • Any discrepancy in personal or roll number details should be reported to SBI through official channels only.

TMB Recruitment 2026: Tamilnad Mercantile Bank Ltd. (TMB), one of India's leading old private sector banks, has released the official notification for the recruitment of Relationship Manager, Product Specialist (Trade Finance), and Mobile Inspector of Branches posts. Interested and eligible candidates can apply online through the official careers portal from 23 July 2026 to 03 August 2026.

The TMB Recruitment 2026 notification invites applications for multiple posts across various cadres. This article provides complete details regarding the recruitment process, including eligibility criteria, age limit, educational qualifications, salary, application fee, selection process, important dates, required documents, and the step-by-step online application procedure.

  • Official Notification PDF For Relationship Manager Posts
  • Apply Online For Relationship Manager Posts
  • Official Notification PDF For Product Specialist (Trade Finance) Posts
  • Apply Online For Product Specialist (Trade Finance) Posts
  • Official Notification PDF For Mobile Inspector of Branches Posts
  • Apply Online For Mobile Inspector of Branches Posts
  • TMB Official Website

TMB Recruitment 2026 - Quick Overview

Particulars Details
Organisation Tamilnad Mercantile Bank Ltd. (TMB)
Posts Advertised Relationship Manager, Product Specialist (Trade Finance), Mobile Inspector of Branches
Mode of Application Online only
Application Start Date 23.07.2026
Application Last Date 03.08.2026
Selection Process Personal Interview (Direct / Video Conferencing)
Place of Posting Anywhere in India
Official Website ib.tmbonline.bank.in/tmb_careers/

The exact number of vacancies for each post is not available in the official notification.

TMB Recruitment 2026 Important Dates

  • Opening date for registering online e-application: 23.07.2026
  • Closing date for registering online e-application: 03.08.2026

These dates apply uniformly to all three posts - Relationship Manager, Product Specialist (Trade Finance), and Mobile Inspector of Branches.

TMB Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Eligibility requirements differ for each post. Detailed criteria are given below.

TMB Relationship Manager Eligibility 2026

  • Cadre: Manager / Assistant Manager
  • Educational Qualification: Any Graduation or Post Graduation in first class (60% marks) in any discipline under a regular stream from a recognised university.
  • Age Limit: Not more than 35 years as on 30.06.2026
  • Experience: For Manager - at least 3 years of relevant experience in a bank in sourcing / processing loans / MSME loans / retail loans. For Assistant Manager - at least 2 years of relevant experience in the same areas.
  • Tenor: Regular basis
  • Other Condition: No vigilance case or adverse observation from RBI/Statutory Authority should be pending against the candidate.

TMB Product Specialist (Trade Finance) Eligibility 2026

  • Cadre: Manager / Senior Manager
  • Age Limit: Minimum 28 years and not more than 38 years as on 30.06.2026 (age may be relaxed in deserving cases).
  • Educational Qualification: Any Graduate / Post Graduate from a recognised university under a regular curriculum. Holding a Certified Credit Professional certification and a certification in Foreign Exchange Operations by IIBF is desirable.
  • Experience: At least three years of experience in handling Trade Finance business.
  • Tenor: Regular basis
  • Other Condition: No vigilance case or adverse observation from DAC/Vigilance/RBI/Statutory Authority should be pending against the candidate.

TMB Mobile Inspector of Branches Eligibility 2026

  • Age Limit: Not more than 62 years as on 30.06.2026
  • Who Can Apply: Retired officers of TMB or other banks are eligible for selection from the date of retirement.
  • Cadre at Retirement: Officers must have retired in Scale II, Scale III, or Scale IV cadre. Preference will be given to those with previous work experience in the inspection/audit department.
  • Track Record: Only suitable persons with a good track record and unblemished service are eligible.
  • Disqualification: Officers removed or dismissed from bank service under disciplinary measures are not eligible.
  • Contract Period: Initially engaged for 1 year, renewable for a further 1 year based on satisfactory performance (total 2 years).

TMB Recruitment 2026 Salary and Remuneration

Post Salary / Remuneration
Relationship Manager Not specified in the official notification (regular officer cadre - Manager/Assistant Manager)
Product Specialist (Trade Finance) As applicable to regular officers (Manager / Senior Manager cadre)
Mobile Inspector of Branches Consolidated pay of ₹35,000/- per month. No other allowance or perquisite such as bonus, ex-gratia, variable pay, LFC, or medical reimbursement will be paid. However, lodging expenses and halting allowance applicable to the respective cadre will be paid.

TMB Recruitment 2026 Application Fee

There is no application fee for any of the three posts - Relationship Manager, Product Specialist (Trade Finance), and Mobile Inspector of Branches. Candidates from all categories can apply free of cost.

TMB Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

The selection process is common for all three posts:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be called for a personal interview.
  • The interview will be conducted through Direct mode or Video Conferencing.
  • The mode, date, and time of the interview will be communicated to eligible candidates individually.
  • The bank's decision on eligibility, interview, and selection will be final.

Roles and Responsibilities

Relationship Manager - Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain strong customer relationships and acquire new customers.
  • Promote and cross-sell banking products such as CASA, loans, insurance, and investment products.
  • Achieve assigned sales and business targets.
  • Ensure KYC compliance, handle customer portfolio management, and coordinate onboarding.
  • Assess customer background and risk using CIBIL, CRILC, and Account Aggregator tools.
  • Conduct property and collateral verification using Proplegit for home loans.
  • Visit accounts in SMA 0, 1, and 2 categories along with the collection officer.

Product Specialist (Trade Finance) - Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the primary point of contact for trade finance customers in the region.
  • Facilitate onboarding of new trade finance clients in compliance with regulatory policies.
  • Provide expertise on letters of credit (LCs), bank guarantees, documentary bills collection, trade loans, and export/import financing.
  • Cross-sell cash management, foreign exchange, and treasury solutions.
  • Evaluate creditworthiness and assess risks associated with trade finance transactions.
  • Oversee preparation and verification of trade finance documents for accuracy and compliance.
  • Assist internal and external auditors during trade finance reviews.

Mobile Inspector of Branches - Key Responsibilities

  • Verify that branch activities comply with the bank's internal policies, RBI regulations, and statutory requirements.
  • Check compliance with KYC and AML norms and scrutinise cash transactions for irregularities.
  • Examine loan and advance portfolios, verify cash balance and vault holdings.
  • Identify operational, credit, trade finance, and compliance risks; check for fraud-prone areas.
  • Inspect pledged/mortgaged security items such as gold and title deeds, and verify CCTV/alarm/fire safety systems.
  • Prepare detailed inspection reports covering observations, irregularities, risks, and recommendations.
  • Submit findings to the Regional Office/Head Office Inspection Division and follow up on earlier recommendations.

Required Documents for TMB Recruitment 2026

Candidates must upload the following self-attested documents along with the online application:

  • Self-attested photo copy of SSLC or Higher Secondary Mark Sheet/Transfer Certificate for age proof.
  • Self-attested photo copy of Degree Certificate(s).
  • Experience certificate(s) and Relieving Letter for previous employments.
  • Last month's salary slip.

Photograph and Signature Specifications

Item Dimension Maximum File Size
Photograph 390 x 520 pixels (preferred) 120 KB
Signature 240 x 240 pixels (preferred) 60 KB
Each supporting enclosure - 250 KB

Signatures in capital letters will not be accepted.

How to Apply Online for TMB Recruitment 2026?

  1. Visit the bank's official careers website: ib.tmbonline.bank.in/tmb_careers/
  2. Read the detailed advertisement by clicking "Download Advertisement" under the relevant post title, and confirm your eligibility before applying.
  3. Click "Apply Online" and register yourself for the appropriate post using a valid personal email ID and mobile number.
  4. On successful registration, an activation link will be sent to your registered email ID, and a Registration Number and Password will be sent to your registered mobile number. Note these carefully, as they are required to proceed further.
  5. Click the activation link sent to your email ID to be directed to the Careers portal.
  6. Log in using your Application/Registration Number and Password, and fill in all details carefully, clicking "Save/Continue" on every page. Ensure your name and your father's/husband's name are spelt exactly as per your certificates/mark sheets.
  7. Upload your photograph and signature as per the specified dimensions and file size.
  8. Upload the required enclosures: SSLC/Higher Secondary certificate, Degree certificate, Experience certificate/Relieving letter, and Last month's salary slip.
  9. Click "Confirm/Submit" at the bottom of the page. A message "Registration is successful" will be displayed on successful submission.
  10. A copy of the system-generated application form will be sent to your registered email ID. Take a printout for future reference.

  • E-applications with incorrect or incomplete particulars, or without the required certificate copies, are liable to be rejected.
  • The bank reserves the right to reject any application, or eliminate an ineligible candidate, at any stage of the process without assigning any reason. The bank's decision on eligibility, interview, and selection is final.

IOB Chief Financial Officer Eligibility Criteria 2026

All eligibility criteria (Qualification, Age, Experience, etc.) for this post shall be computed as on 01.07.2026 (inclusive).

Educational/Professional Qualification

  • A qualified Chartered Accountant
  • Preferred: FRM Certification and/or CFA

Work Experience

Minimum fifteen (15) years in overseeing financial operations, preferably accounting and taxation matters, in Banks/large corporates/PSUs/FIs/financial services organizations, of which ten (10) years should be in Banks/FIs, of which five (5) years should be at Senior Management level.

Candidates belonging to categories (ii), (iii), (iv) and (v) above must possess a certificate of eligibility issued by the Government of India before the date of this notification.

IOB Chief Financial Officer: Roles & Responsibilities

  • Financial Reporting & Compliance: Overseeing the statutory auditing process, reporting audit results as per SEBI requirements, monitoring critical financial parameters (Non-Interest Income, ROA, ROE etc.), coordinating with NFRA and RBI on auditor-related issues, and handling Whole Bank Long Form Audit Report (WBLFAR) matters.
  • Tax Compliance: Optimization of the Bank's tax liability, GST and TDS compliance.
  • Accounting Systems: Developing and maintaining accounting systems per Accounting Standards and RBI Guidelines, Internal Financial Controls over Financial Reporting (IFCOFR), and implementation of IFRS/IND AS.
  • Management Reporting: Coordinating with the Financial Control Department for review of regional and Whole Bank performance.
  • International Banking Activities: Supporting the International Banking Group on accounting and tax compliance as per local regulators.
  • Other Activities: Overseeing MIS reporting systems, strategic capital planning, balance sheet optimization, medium-term financial strategy, and managing stakeholder relationships with regulators, government, rating agencies, and investors.

IOB Chief Financial Officer Selection Process 2026

  • Selection will be through Personal Interview/Discussion. The Bank may carry out a preliminary screening of applications to shortlist eligible candidates based on qualifications, suitability, and experience.
  • Total marks allocated for the Personal Interview: 100.
  • Minimum qualifying marks: 50 (45 for OBC/SC/ST/PwBD candidates).
  • In case multiple candidates score the same cut-off marks, ranking will be done according to age, in descending order.
  • The Bank may change the mode of selection depending on the number of applications received.
  • Merely fulfilling the minimum qualification and experience criteria does not automatically entitle a candidate to an interview call; the Bank may consider additional qualifications, greater experience, and level of responsibilities handled while shortlisting.

IOB Chief Financial Officer: Joining, Bond & Probation

  • The selected candidate, at the time of joining, must execute a Bond of Rs. 3 lakhs to serve the Bank for a stipulated period of 3 years. The Bond will be invoked if the candidate resigns before the expiry of the bond period from the date of joining.
  • On joining, the selected candidate will be on probation for a period of 1 year and subjected to continuous assessment. Confirmation depends on qualifying the assessment as per standards determined by the Bank.
  • If the candidate fails to achieve the minimum stipulated standards, their services may be terminated.

How to Apply for IOB Chief Financial Officer Recruitment 2026?

  1. Visit the Bank's official website www.iob.bank.in and go to the "Careers" page.
  2. Click on "RECRUITMENT OF CHIEF FINANCIAL OFFICER" and select the post to be applied for.
  3. Click on the "Register Online" link and complete first-time registration by clicking "Click here to Register Online".
  4. Note the system-generated Registration Number and Password sent via email and SMS.
  5. Upload photograph and signature as per the specifications in the Guidelines for Scanning and Upload of Photograph and Signature (Annexure I).
  6. Fill in all required details carefully in the Online Application Form.
  7. Upload the mandatory documents: Birth/SSC Certificate, Final Degree Certificate/Consolidated Mark Sheet, CA Certificate, and Work Experience Certificate (PDF, each under 200KB); upload NOC from employer, if applicable.
  8. Click on "COMPLETE REGISTRATION" at the end of the form.
  9. Proceed to pay the Application Fee/Intimation Charges through Online Mode (Debit Card/Credit Card/Net Banking).
  10. Take a printout of the system-generated submitted online application form and the payment e-receipt for future reference.

Union Bank of India Recruitment 2026: Age Limit

Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC is cumulative with only one of the remaining categories (PwBD/Ex-servicemen/1984 riot-affected). There is no reservation for Ex-servicemen in the Officers' Cadre vacancies.

Union Bank of India Recruitment 2026: Selection Process

For posts up to Scale III, selection may comprise Online Examination, Group Discussion (if required), and/or Personal Interview, depending on the number of applicants. For posts in Scale IV, V, and VI, selection may comprise Group Discussion (if required), any other test/assessment, and/or Personal Interview. The Bank reserves the right to add, cancel, or modify the selection method for any notified post.

Online Examination Structure - Specialist Officers (Post Codes S01–S108, up to Scale III)

Test No. of Questions Maximum Marks Duration

Online Examination Structure - General Banking Officers (Post Codes G01–G19, up to Scale III)

Quantitative Aptitude, Reasoning, and English Language sections are qualifying in nature - marks in these are not counted toward final merit. All tests except English Language are available bilingually (English and Hindi). Minimum qualifying marks: 40% for General/EWS categories, 35% for reserved categories (SC/ST/OBC/PwBD), subject to the Bank's discretion. There is a penalty of 25% of the marks assigned to a question for each wrong answer; unattempted questions carry no penalty.

Personal Interview

A Personal Interview of 100 marks assesses academic and job knowledge, power of expression, clarity of thought, leadership qualities, communication skills, and suitability for the post. Minimum qualifying marks: 50 for General/EWS, 45 for Reserved Category (SC/ST/OBC/PwBD). Candidates are called for interview in the ratio of 1:3 against the number of vacancies (subject to change at the Bank's discretion).

Final Merit

Final selection is based on the aggregate marks of Online Examination and Personal Interview (or Personal Interview alone, or GD/other assessment plus Personal Interview, depending on which stages are conducted), prepared in descending order category-wise, up to the number of vacancies. In case of a tie, the candidate senior in age (earlier date of birth) is ranked higher.

  • Printout of the valid Interview Call Letter
  • System-generated printout of the online application form
  • Proof of Date of Birth (Birth Certificate or SSLC/Std. X Certificate with DOB)

  • Scribe declaration form, if services of a scribe were used

  • No Objection Certificate from employer (for candidates serving in Government/PSU/Bank)
  • Experience certificate in the prescribed format (Annexure-II of the notification), issued by the Competent Authority of the employer, clearly stating period, post held, and nature of duties

Appointment letters, salary certificates, and pay slips are not accepted as proof of work experience.

Union Bank of India Recruitment 2026: How to Apply

  1. Visit the official website www.unionbankofindia.co.in and click on the 'Recruitment' page.
  2. On the Career Overview page, click 'Click to View the Current Recruitment' to open the link "UNION BANK RECRUITMENT PROJECT 2026-27 (OFFICERS WITH DOMAIN EXPERTISE, GENERAL BANKING OFFICERS & SPECIALIST OFFICERS)".
  3. Click on "CLICK HERE TO APPLY ONLINE" to open the online application form.
  4. Choose "Click here for New Registration" and enter your Name, contact details, and Email ID. Note down the system-generated Provisional Registration Number and Password.
  5. Use the "SAVE AND NEXT" option to fill the application in stages if needed, and verify all details carefully - no changes are allowed after clicking "COMPLETE REGISTRATION".
  6. Upload photograph, signature, and left thumb impression as per the prescribed specifications.
  7. Fill in the remaining application details, preview the form, and click "COMPLETE REGISTRATION".
  8. Click on the "Payment" tab and pay the applicable application fee online.
  9. Click 'Submit' and save/print the system-generated application form and e-receipt for future reference.

Candidates can apply for only one post. Only the last valid, complete application will be retained in case of multiple submissions. An application, once submitted, cannot be withdrawn, and the fee is non-refundable.

Union Bank of India Recruitment 2026: Important Instructions

  • Application can be made for only one post; multiple appearances for a single post at interview will lead to cancellation of candidature.
  • No change of category will be permitted at any stage after registration of the online application.
  • Existing Union Bank of India employees may apply through proper channel (HR Department of Regional/Zonal Office) and, if selected, must resign and rejoin the Bank's service afresh.
  • Selected candidates will be on probation for 2 years of active service.
  • Selected candidates for posts G01–G19 must execute a Service Indemnity Bond to serve the Bank for a minimum of 3 years, or pay ₹2,00,000 plus applicable taxes if they leave before completing 3 years.
  • Selected candidates for posts S01–S108 must execute a Service Indemnity Bond to serve the Bank for a minimum of 3 years, or pay ₹2,50,000 plus applicable taxes if they leave before completing 3 years.
  • Selected candidates shall be posted at any Branch/Office of the Bank throughout India at the Bank's sole discretion.
  • The Bank reserves the right to change/modify the number of vacancies, examination structure, or cancel the recruitment process at any stage.
  • Any dispute arising out of the notification is subject to the sole jurisdiction of courts in Mumbai.

RRB Group D City Intimation Slip and Admit Card 2026

  • The first City Intimation Slip was released on 24th July 2026.
  • The E-Call Letter (Admit Card) becomes available approximately 4 days before the date mentioned in the City Intimation Slip.
  • The first Admit Card release is reported as 31st July 2026.
  • Since the CBT is being conducted in multiple phases through August 2026, City Intimation Slips and Admit Cards will continue to be released in batches closer to each phase's exam dates.
  • Candidates must carry the Admit Card to the exam centre; entry will not be permitted without it.

Aadhaar-Based Biometric Authentication: Important Instructions

The official notice places strong emphasis on Aadhaar verification for CEN 09/2025 candidates:

  • Aadhaar-linked biometric authentication is mandatory at the exam centre before entry into the exam hall.
  • Candidates must carry either their original Aadhaar card or a printout of e-verified Aadhaar.
  • Candidates who have not completed Aadhaar verification are advised to do so in advance by logging into the official portal with their registered credentials.
  • Even candidates who verified Aadhaar during the application stage must ensure their Aadhaar status is "unlocked" in the UIDAI system before arriving at the centre. A locked Aadhaar can cause avoidable delays during registration on exam day.
  • Candidates are advised to check their Aadhaar lock/unlock status on the official UIDAI portal a few days before the exam.

How to Check RRB Group D Exam City, Date and Admit Card

  1. Visit the official website of your respective RRB region (linked via rrbapply.gov.in).
  2. Look for the "CEN 09/2025 Group D - City Intimation Slip / Admit Card" link once it is activated for your phase.
  3. Log in using your registration number and date of birth or password.
  4. Download and take a printout of the City Intimation Slip and, later, the Admit Card.
  5. Verify your Aadhaar unlock status on the UIDAI portal before the exam date.

RRB Group D 2026: What Candidates Should Do Next

  • Revise core subjects: Mathematics, General Intelligence and Reasoning, General Science, and General Awareness on Current Affairs.
  • Practice previous years' RRB Group D papers and full-length mock tests.
  • Keep login credentials for rrbapply.gov.in ready for Aadhaar verification and e-call letter download.
  • Check the official RRB regional website regularly for exam city, date, and admit card updates specific to your phase.

The Physical Efficiency Test (PET) is being conducted from 25th July 2026 to 11th September 2026, with dates varying by zone. As of 30th July 2026, PET schedules have been announced for Ajmer, Chennai, Prayagraj, Bhopal, Bilaspur, Chandigarh, Ranchi, Kolkata, and Mumbai zones, while some zones (including Patna and Hubballi) have been postponed and several others are yet to release their schedule. RRB Group D Ajmer PET Exam Date 2026

The Railway Recruitment Cell (RRC), Jaipur has scheduled the PET for candidates shortlisted under CEN No. 08/2024 from 29 July to 31 July 2026, with 1 August 2026 kept as a final opportunity for candidates unable to appear earlier for valid reasons. The test is being held at G.L.O. Ground, A.D.S.A. Stadium, near DRM Office, Mall Road, Ajmer. Male candidates must report at 6:00 AM, and female/transgender candidates at 9:00 AM on the final PET day. Candidates must carry their e-call letter, original photo ID, and original Aadhaar card candidates without these documents will not be permitted to appear.

The RRB Group D Prayagraj PET was conducted from 25 to 28 July 2026 at DSA Ground, near Prayagraj Railway Station. The RRC, North Central Railway has already declared the PET result, with 251 candidates qualifying for the next stage Document Verification and Medical Examination.

  1. Hearing – Candidate should have normal hearing i.e. able to hear forced whisper from a distance of 6 meters by each ear separately.

How to Calculate Marks Using the RRB MI Answer Key?

The RRB Ministerial & Isolated Categories CBT carries 100 marks for 100 questions. Use the following marking scheme to estimate your score:

  • Correct Answer: +1 mark
  • Incorrect Answer: -1/3 (0.33) mark deducted
  • Unattempted Question: 0 marks

Formula: Total Marks = (Number of Correct Answers × 1) - (Number of Wrong Answers × 0.33)

  4. Upload a valid justification or supporting reference (textbook page, authoritative source, etc.) for each challenged question. Objections without proof are not considered.
  5. Pay the objection fee of Rs. 50 per question (plus applicable bank charges) via Debit Card, Credit Card, UPI, or Net Banking.
  6. Submit the form and save the confirmation/acknowledgement for future reference.

How to Raise an Online Objection Against the Answer Key

Candidates can follow these steps to submit an objection through the CGPSC website:

  1. Visit the official CGPSC website and log in to the candidate dashboard.
  2. Go to the Activity Section and click on Objection Filing.
  3. On the new page, select the exam name, question paper, set, and the question number you want to object to.
  4. Select the applicable type of objection (see list below).
  5. Clearly write the reason for the objection in the box provided.
  6. Upload supporting proof as a PDF document (maximum size 1MB per question). Proof must include the source name, author, edition/publication date, and reference page number — mere links or website names without this detail will not be accepted.
  7. Use the Add button to submit multiple objections; unwanted entries can be removed before final submission.
  8. Click Save after entering all objections.
  9. Proceed to the fee payment page and click Pay Now to pay Rs. 50 per question for all objections raised.
  10. After successful payment, download the acknowledgement/receipt from the Dashboard under Activity Section > Download Acknowledgement.

Types of Objections Accepted

Objection Type Description
All Answer Options Incorrect All given options for a question are wrong
Commission's Answer Option Incorrect The answer option released by the commission is wrong
More Than One Correct Option More than one answer option is correct
Question is Wrong The question itself is incorrect
Question Out of Syllabus The question is not part of the prescribed syllabus
Hindi-English Translation Mismatch There is a factual difference between the Hindi and English translation of the question

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • Objections can be submitted only through the online mode; no offline application or document will be accepted at the commission office.
  • Candidates get only one opportunity to submit all objections together; once the fee is paid, the process is considered complete and objections cannot be filed again.
  • Candidates are responsible for avoiding phishing, hacking, or other cyber risks during online banking/payment.
  • If the fee payment is unsuccessful, if entries are made in different sets of the same question paper, or if the prescribed process is not followed correctly, the submitted objection will be automatically rejected, and no request/appeal regarding this will be entertained by the commission.

Deleted & Reasoned Questions - Details by Subject

General Studies (Paper-I)

Question 1 in Series-A (corresponding to Q31 in Series-B, Q61 in Series-C, and Q81 in Series-D) has been marked "Deleted" in the final key. No written reason is printed against this entry in the official document; all candidates will receive marks for this question.

Physics (Paper-II, Optional)

Three questions have been deleted in the final Physics key. Using Series-A numbering, these are Q87 (Series-B: 52, Series-C: 67, Series-D: 82), Q92 (Series-B: 57, Series-C: 72, Series-D: 87), and Q99 (Series-B: 64, Series-C: 79, Series-D: 94). The official PDF does not include a reason column for this subject, so no explanation is printed against these deletions.

Chemistry (Paper-II, Optional)

Question 6 in Series-A (Series-B: 21, Series-C: 36, Series-D: 1) has been deleted. The official reason states that the question contained a printing mistake in a chemical formula, which made the question ambiguous, so it has been dropped from evaluation for all candidates.

Life Science (Paper-II, Optional)

No question has been deleted in the Life Science final key. One answer (Series-A Q82) carries an added explanatory note on food-chain trophic levels - producers, primary/secondary consumers, and decomposers - to justify the chosen correct option, but the question itself stands and has not been dropped.

Environmental Science (Paper-II, Optional)

Two questions have been deleted:

  • Series-A Q31 (Series-B: 46, Series-C: 11, Series-D: 26) - deleted because certain districts of Karnataka and Kerala have rainforest cover in addition to the option listed as fully rainforest, creating more than one correct option.
  • Series-A Q46 (Series-B: 11, Series-C: 26, Series-D: 41) - deleted because the correct answer (an animal recognized as the symbol of the World Wildlife Fund) was not present among the listed options.

Two further answers carry explanatory notes without being deleted: one clarifies that decomposers hold the largest population share in a food chain, and another confirms that pH is a logarithmic function in the mathematical sense, supporting an Assertion-Reason type question.

Based on the recruitment notification for this post, the written exam consists of Paper-I - General Studies (100 marks) and Paper-II - Optional Subject (300 marks), with 0.33 marks (1/3) deducted for every wrong answer. To estimate your score:

  1. Note your question-booklet series (A/B/C/D) from your admit card.
  2. Match each of your recorded responses against the correct answer in that series column of the final key.
  3. Award full marks for every correct match.
  4. Deduct 0.33 marks for every incorrect match.
  5. Treat questions marked "Deleted" as correct for all candidates, regardless of the option chosen or left unattempted.

Important Instructions

  • The released document is the final answer key, issued after review of objections raised against the provisional key (objection window: 08 July 2026 to 12 July 2026).
  • Match your answers only against the series (A/B/C/D) printed on your own question booklet - answers differ by series even though the underlying questions are the same.
  • Questions marked "Deleted" are treated as correct for every candidate and do not require any action from candidates.
  • Download the General Studies key along with only the optional subject you actually appeared for.
  • Refer to the official BPSC website for the result date and further updates, as this is not mentioned in the final answer key documents.

Once the objection window closes, UPSC evaluates all valid representations and releases the final answer key. This is followed by the declaration of the Paper 1 result. About UPSC Indian Statistical Service (ISS) Examination 2026

The ISS Examination is one of the premier competitive exams conducted by UPSC to recruit officers for Group A and Group B posts in the Indian Statistical Service. Understanding the exam structure helps candidates correctly interpret the provisional answer key.

The Indian Statistical Service (ISS) Examination is conducted annually by the Union Public Service Commission to fill vacancies in the Indian Statistical Service, one of India's organised Group A Central Services. The exam tests candidates on subjects including Statistics, General English, and General Studies. The Statistics papers are the most technical and weightage-heavy components of the exam. The provisional answer key released covers the objective/multiple-choice components of the Statistics papers.

If a candidate disagrees with any answer published in the provisional answer key, they can submit a formal representation to UPSC within the stipulated objection window period.

UPSC allows candidates to challenge answers in the provisional answer key by submitting a formal representation. The process for raising objections is as follows:

  • Download the provisional answer key PDF for the relevant paper.
  • Identify the question number(s) where you believe the answer is incorrect.
  • Prepare a written representation with supporting references from standard textbooks or study material.
  • Submit the representation to UPSC through the official channel specified in the answer key notification (typically by post or online submission to the UPSC office).

After the provisional answer key is released and the objection window closes, UPSC reviews all valid representations before publishing the Final Answer Key.

Once the objection period ends, UPSC's subject matter experts review all representations submitted by candidates. Valid objections where an answer is found to be incorrect based on credible references result in changes to the final answer key. The Final Answer Key is then published on the official website. The final marks are computed based on the final (not provisional) answer key, which forms the basis for merit list preparation and eventual selection to the Indian Statistical Service.

  • Company: Lenskart
  • Location: Rajkot
  • Compensation: ₹ 3,00,000 - 3,50,000 ₹ 3,00,000 - 3,50,000 /year
  • Experience: No experience required
Key Skills
MultitaskingProblem SolvingClient RelationshipEnglish Proficiency (Spoken)English Proficiency (Written)AdaptabilitySales
Role Snapshot
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store. Key responsibilities: A. Customer focus: 1. Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up. 2. He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers. 3. He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively. 4. He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has. B. Product recommendation: 1. With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales. 2. He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions. C. Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence: 1. Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently. 2. Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pickup, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage. D. Store upkeep & maintenance: 1. He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly. 2. He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store. Note: This role requires working 6 days a week with a rotational week-off and rotational shifts based on business requirements. Please note that there are no night shifts. Training information: Candidates selected for the role after successfully completing the interview process will be attending a one month mandatory offline training program at a designated Lenskart Academy, which is an integral part of the onboarding process. Performance-based incentives will be provided

Position Overview

The Data Entry Administrator is responsible for accurately entering, updating, verifying, and maintaining company data while ensuring the highest standards of quality and confidentiality. This role requires excellent attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to work independently in a remote environment. The successful candidate will help ensure that business records remain complete, accurate, and accessible, contributing directly to operational efficiency.

  • Maintain confidential information in accordance with company policies and applicable privacy regulations.
  • Collaborate with internal departments to obtain missing or updated information.
  • Prioritize tasks to meet deadlines while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
  • Support administrative projects and perform additional data-related tasks as assigned.
